title: Kink boundary-induced polarity revealed by nonreciprocal charge transport in FeTe0.7Se0.3 superconductor
summary: Nonreciprocal charge transport, characterized by direction-dependent electrical response, provides a powerful probe of electronic structure and a platform for rectification. However, its realization is typically governed by intrinsic crystal symmetry, restricting the range of suitable materials. Here, we demonstrate nonreciprocal charge transport in an otherwise centrosymmetric superconductor, FeTe0.7Se0.3 (FTS), through kink boundary-induced strain engineering. The stress relaxation during growth generates a cusp-like kink-band boundary with asymmetric curvature, producing a spatially nonuniform strain field and an effective in-plane polarity that breaks inversion symmetry. Pronounced nonreciprocal transport is observed under out-of-plane magnetic fields, with strong dependence on current and temperature across the superconducting transition, in contrast to the negligible response in flat nanosheets. Our results identify kink boundary-induced symmetry breaking as a general route to engineer nonreciprocal charge transport in centrosymmetric systems.

AI.tldr: 在中心对称超导体FeTe0.7Se0.3中，通过生长过程中扭结带（kink band）边界诱导的应变工程打破反演对称性，实现了显著的非互易电荷输运。
AI.motivation: 非互易电荷输运通常受材料本征晶体对称性限制，可选材料范围狭窄，因此需要一种不依赖本征结构、能在中心对称体系中实现非互易输运的通用手段。
AI.method: 生长FTS纳米片时利用应力弛豫形成具有不对称曲率的尖点状扭结带边界，产生空间非均匀应变场与等效面内极性、打破反演对称性；随后在面外磁场、不同电流与温度条件下测量输运响应，并与平整纳米片对照。
AI.result: 在面外磁场下观测到明显的非互易输运，其强度随电流和温度在超导转变区呈现强依赖，而平整纳米片响应可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 扭结边界诱导的对称性破缺可作为一种在中心对称体系中工程化非互易电荷输运的通用路径。

title: Driven Vortex Motion in Periodic Channel Potential Embedded in Superconducting Films
summary: In this paper, we investigate vortex dynamics in periodically width-modulated superconducting channels by numerically solving the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau (TDGL) equations. The channels are designed with sinusoidally varying widths characterized by their average width and modulation amplitude. The motion of driven vortices generates an oscillatory electric field with a fundamental frequency, $f_0$, set by the channel periodicity, together with higher-order harmonics. In contrast to the situation of vortex lattice dynamics in a periodic pinning landscape of circular holes considered by Al Luhaibi et al. [1], we show that the harmonic content of the generated electric field can be effectively controlled through the channel geometry. In particular, appropriately engineered channel profiles strongly suppress higher-order harmonics, yielding an electric-field response that closely approaches a pure sinusoidal waveform. These results demonstrate that geometric modulation offers a viable route to engineering low-harmonicity microwave signals in superconducting devices and may enable cryogenic on-chip waveform generators for controlling superconducting qubits. Such devices could provide a useful building block for scalable transmon-based quantum computing architectures.

AI.tldr: 通过数值求解TDGL方程研究周期宽度调制超导通道中的涡旋动力学，发现几何调制可有效控制电场谐波含量，特定通道轮廓能抑制高次谐波、逼近纯正弦波形，为超导器件中低谐波微波信号产生及片上低温波形发生器提供途径。
AI.motivation: 此前Al Luhaibi等研究的是圆形孔洞周期钉扎势下涡旋点阵动力学，本文希望探索能否通过通道几何（而非钉扎势）来主动调控驱动涡旋所产生电场的谐波成分，以服务于超导量子计算所需的低谐波微波信号源。
AI.method: 对呈正弦式宽度变化的超导通道（以平均宽度和调制幅度为特征参数）数值求解含时Ginzburg-Landau（TDGL）方程，分析驱动涡旋运动产生的基频$f_0$（由通道周期决定）及高阶谐波，并比较不同几何轮廓对谐波谱的影响。
AI.result: 驱动涡旋产生以通道周期性决定的基频$f_0$为主、并含高次谐波的振荡电场；与圆形孔洞钉扎阵列情形不同，通道几何可有效调控谐波含量，经过恰当设计的通道轮廓能强烈抑制高次谐波，使电场响应接近纯正弦波形。
AI.conclusion: 几何调制是实现低谐波微波信号的一种可行途径，可用于超导器件中的低温片上波形发生器，进而控制超导量子比特，为可扩展的transmon量子计算架构提供有用构件。

title: High-mobility spin transport mediated by indirect excitons in a van der Waals heterostructure
summary: Efficient spin transport with high spin mobility is of both fundamental and practical significance for spintronics. Spin can be transferred by moving particles. However, particle scattering limits spin transfer and prevents high spin mobilities. In this work, we study the kinetics of spin transport mediated by a quantum system of indirect excitons (IXs) in a van der Waals heterostructure composed of atomically thin transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). This spin transfer mechanism allows for the realization of efficient spin transport characterized by a high spin mobility reaching 10$^5$ cm$^2$/(eV$\cdot$s), which is orders of magnitude higher than that achieved via standard diffusive spin transport in TMD materials. The suppression of IX scattering enables high-mobility spin transport.

AI.tldr: 在TMD范德华异质结中，利用间接激子(IXs)介导自旋输运，抑制粒子散射，实现高达10^5 cm^2/(eV·s)的自旋迁移率，比标准扩散自旋输运高数个量级。
AI.motivation: 自旋的高效输运与高自旋迁移率对自旋电子学兼具基础与应用意义。自旋可通过粒子运动传递，但粒子散射限制自旋转移，从而阻碍高自旋迁移率的实现。
AI.method: 研究由原子级薄过渡金属硫族化合物(TMD)构成的范德华异质结中，间接激子(IXs)量子系统介导的自旋输运动力学。
AI.result: 该自旋转移机制实现高效自旋输运，自旋迁移率高达10^5 cm^2/(eV·s)，比TMD材料中标准扩散式自旋输运高数个数量级；IXs散射的抑制是高迁移率自旋输运的关键。
AI.conclusion: IXs介导的自旋输运通过抑制散射突破粒子散射对自旋迁移率的限制，为高迁移率自旋输运提供新途径。

title: Selective faceting induced by Hexagonal Boron Nitride on curved Platinum substrate
summary: This work combines experimental investigations and first-principles calculations to study hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) growth on a curved Pt(331) substrate. Low-energy electron diffraction (LEED) and scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM) were employed to investigate the structural properties, observing that hBN growth led to faceting with several stable facets: Pt(111), Pt(221), Pt(441), Pt(881), and Pt(110). Additionally, the electronic properties were examined by X-ray photoemission spectroscopy (XPS) and near-edge X-ray absorption fine structure (NEXAFS), revealing an increase in the hBN-substrate interaction strength, from the weakest at the Pt(111) to the strongest at the Pt(110). Density functional theory (DFT) calculations confirm that the selective faceting mechanism is induced by hBN, which changes the order of relative stability of the uncovered facets. Although a complete understanding of the process is not achievable using only thermodynamical arguments, the comparison between hBN adhesion energies and clean surface free energies clearly indicates that some facets are stabilized with respect to others by stronger overlayer-substrate interaction, whereas for others the clean surface energetics plays the dominant role.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合实验与第一性原理计算，研究六方氮化硼(hBN)在曲面Pt(331)衬底上的生长，揭示了hBN诱导的选择性刻面化及不同Pt晶面上hBN-衬底相互作用的差异。
AI.motivation: 探究hBN在复杂/曲面金属衬底生长时的结构演化及衬底晶面对界面相互作用的影响，理解刻面形成的物理机制。
AI.method: 实验上采用LEED和STM表征结构，XPS和NEXAFS表征电子性质；理论上用DFT计算比较hBN粘附能与清洁表面自由能。
AI.result: hBN生长使表面刻面化为Pt(111)、Pt(221)、Pt(441)、Pt(881)、Pt(110)等稳定晶面；hBN-衬底相互作用从Pt(111)最弱到Pt(110)最强依次增强；DFT确认刻面选择性由hBN改变各刻面相对稳定性顺序所致。
AI.conclusion: hBN诱导的选择性刻面化无法仅用热力学解释，需同时考虑hBN粘附能与清洁表面能量的竞争：部分晶面因强界面相互作用而稳定，另一些则由清洁表面能主导。

title: Proof of the exact correlation-length exponent $ν= \frac{\sqrt[3]{2}}{2}$ and algebraic relations for $β$ and $γ$ in the 3D Ising model
summary: Based on our previous results regarding critical exponent estimates for the 3D Ising model and scaling relations [1], we have proven that the exact value of the correlation-length exponent is $\frac{\sqrt[3]{2}}{2}$. This is in very close agreement with the most precise numerical estimates currently available. Using a group theoretical approach and some propositions of constructive geometry, we derived an exact construction of algebraic expressions for the critical exponents $γ$ and $β$. We proved that these expressions depend solely on the exact value of $ν\,$.

AI.tldr: 本文声称利用群论方法与构造几何命题，证明了3D Ising模型关联长度临界指数ν的精确值为∛2/2，并据此得到γ和β的精确代数表达式，与现有最精确数值估计高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 作者此前已对3D Ising模型的临界指数和标度关系给出估计，希望进一步得到临界指数的精确解析值，而非依赖数值拟合，从而为标度关系提供严格的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用群论方法结合构造几何中的若干命题，在既有临界指数估计与标度关系的基础上，推导ν的精确值∛2/2，并构造γ与β的代数表达式，证明它们仅依赖于ν的精确值。
AI.result: 证明ν = ∛2/2，该值与当前最精确的数值估计非常接近；并由群论与构造几何方法得到γ和β的精确代数表达式，证明二者仅由ν精确决定。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为已获得3D Ising模型临界指数的精确解析值，其ν值与高精度数值结果一致，表明该代数构造方式可能揭示了临界指数背后的深层结构，但仍需独立验证与更严格的数学证明。

title: Superlattice-Stabilized Fractional Chern Insulators in a "Berry Basin" Model
summary: The discovery of integer and fractional Chern insulators in rhombohedral graphene, following their discovery in the isolated topological flat band in twisted MoTe$_2$, motivates a search for the conditions under which an electronic band can host a topological correlated state. In this Letter we introduce a ``Berry basin" model which captures the essential features of rhombohedral graphene: a dispersive band with a flat bottom, momentum-space winding of a ``layer" degree of freedom, and Coulomb interactions, while also including periodic potentials, enabling controlled studies of the interplay of quantum geometry, superlattice modulation, and electron-electron interactions in producing correlated topological states beyond the isolated topological band paradigm. While integer Chern insulators emerge at strong coupling without a superlattice potential, stabilizing the fractional state requires nonzero potential for all interaction strengths we access. We provide insight into the greater robustness of integer and fractional Chern insulators in rhombohedral graphene when electrons are polarized away from the moiré interface. Our results establish a new class of systems that host robust fractional Chern insulators and provide a controlled numerical platform to test competing theories of interacting topological phases.

AI.tldr: 提出"Berry basin"模型，用含色散平底能带、层自由度动量空间缠绕与周期性势的相互作用体系，研究菱面体石墨烯中整数量子与分数量子陈绝缘体的形成条件，发现分数态在所有可达相互作用强度下都需要非零超晶格势。
AI.motivation: 菱面体石墨烯中已发现整数量子和分数量子陈绝缘体，此前这类态主要出现在MoTe₂的孤立拓扑平带中。论文希望厘清：一个电子能带在何种条件下能承载拓扑关联态，并突破"孤立拓扑平带"这一范式。
AI.method: 构造"Berry basin"模型，提取菱面体石墨烯的本质要素：具有平坦底部的色散能带、层自由度在动量空间的缠绕、库仑相互作用，并额外引入周期性（超晶格）势，从而可控地研究量子几何、超晶格调制与电子-电子相互作用三者的竞争。
AI.result: 无超晶格势时，强耦合下即可出现整数量子陈绝缘体；但在所研究的所有相互作用强度下，稳定分数量子陈绝缘体都需要非零的周期性势。此外，当电子被极化远离莫尔界面时，整数与分数陈绝缘体都更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了一类可承载稳健分数量子陈绝缘体的新体系，并提供了一个可控的数值平台，用于检验关于相互作用拓扑相的竞争理论。

title: Local Suppression of Superconductivity in Niobium Films by Focused Silicon Ion Implantation
summary: Magnetic flux trapped in a superconducting circuit shifts the critical currents of nearby Josephson junctions and disturbs the operation of the circuit. The usual remedy is a moat etched through the ground plane to hold the flux away from the logic. We report direct write silicon ion implantation with a focused ion beam as a way to make moats without etching the film, by locally suppressing superconductivity in niobium (Nb). Single implanted lines were written across Nb electrodes in films of three thicknesses over two orders of magnitude in ion fluence, and the transition temperature, resistance, and critical current density of each line were measured. The transition temperature of the line falls with fluence while the surrounding Nb is unchanged, and the critical current density falls by about two orders of magnitude before the line becomes resistive at 4.2 K. The product of the critical current and the resistance of the lines follows a single power law in reduced temperature. This gives an estimate of the critical current of a line at any temperature from its transition temperature and resistance. A time dependent Ginzburg-Landau simulation indicates that an implanted region can capture and hold a vortex. From these results we suggest a starting ion energy and fluence for implanted moats in a 100 nm Nb ground plane at 4.2 K and estimate the equivalent broad beam fluence.

AI.tldr: 利用聚焦离子束直接写入硅离子注入，在Nb薄膜中局部抑制超导性以形成"护城河"（moat），无需刻蚀即可阻挡磁通涡旋进入逻辑区域。
AI.motivation: 超导电路中捕获的磁通会移动附近约瑟夫森结的临界电流，干扰电路工作；传统方法靠刻蚀接地层形成沟槽护城河隔离磁通，本文希望用不刻蚀薄膜的方式实现同样功能。
AI.method: 对三种厚度的Nb薄膜，用聚焦离子束以跨两个数量级的注量直接写入单条Si离子注入线，测量每条线的转变温度、电阻和临界电流密度；并用含时Ginzburg-Landau模拟验证注入区能否捕获并束缚涡旋。
AI.result: 注入线转变温度随注量下降而周围Nb不变；临界电流密度在4.2 K变为阻性前下降约两个数量级；临界电流与电阻之积随约化温度遵循单一幂律，可由转变温度和电阻估算任意温度下的临界电流；TDGL模拟表明注入区可捕获并保持涡旋。
AI.conclusion: 提出100 nm Nb接地层在4.2 K下植入护城河的起始离子能量与注量建议，并估算了等效宽束注量，证明离子注入护城河是替代刻蚀的可行方案。

title: Pressure-transferable universal machine-learning potentials: the WBM-MatPES benchmark and Tuga-FF
summary: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials hold the promise to replace costly ab initio calculations in materials science workflows. However, the accuracy and transferability of current models are limited by the availability of training data. We release WBM-MatPES, a dataset of 182 thousand structures recomputed with consistent MatPES settings, together with two reference convex hulls of different depths and test sets at six pressures up to 150 GPa. These datasets reproduce a realistic discovery workflow and allow potentials to be ranked systematically at this level of theory, similar to the Matbench Discovery leaderboard at the Materials Project settings. In this benchmark, five published MatPES potentials agree within 12 meV/atom at 25 GPa, yet their errors increase dramatically to 0.4-5 eV/atom at 150 GPa. To address this limitation, we develop Tuga-FF, a graph transformer trained on datasets spanning ambient and high-pressure configurations alike. Tuga-FF is the most accurate model in the benchmark at ambient pressure, with an energy error of 13.6 meV/atom, and maintains an error of just 21 meV/atom at 150 GPa. We believe this benchmark will encourage the community to train higher-accuracy models and generate richer datasets, advancing machine-learned interatomic potentials as a whole.

AI.tldr: 发布WBM-MatPES数据集（18.2万结构、两条凸包、六种压力测试集至150 GPa）用于系统评测通用机器学习势，并提出Tuga-FF模型，在常压和高压下均取得最优精度。
AI.motivation: 通用机器学习原子间势有望替代昂贵的从头算计算，但其精度与可迁移性受训练数据不足限制，尤其缺乏对高压等分布外条件的系统评测基准。
AI.method: 重新计算18.2万个结构并统一MatPES设置，构建不同深度参考凸包及6个压力（最高150 GPa）测试集，形成模拟真实发现流程的排行榜式基准；同时训练图Transformer模型Tuga-FF，其训练数据涵盖常压与高压构型。
AI.result: 基准中五个已发表MatPES势在25 GPa下互相一致（偏差12 meV/atom以内），但150 GPa下误差剧增至0.4–5 eV/atom；Tuga-FF常压能量误差13.6 meV/atom，为基准最佳，150 GPa下仍保持21 meV/atom。
AI.conclusion: 高压是当前通用势的主要短板，覆盖高压配置的训练数据可显著提升鲁棒性；该基准有望推动社区训练更高精度模型、生成更丰富数据集。

title: Chirally pinned flat bands, helical minibands, and bias-controlled topology of Jackiw-Rebbi states in a periodically modulated Dirac mass texture
summary: Flat bands amplify interactions into correlated phases, and topological bound states are robust by principle; combining the two in a model that is both exactly analyzable and experimentally accessible is therefore especially desirable. Here we show that a square-lattice model with a slowly modulated Dirac mass texture, $m(x)=m+m_0\cos(2πx/L)$ with $L$ up to hundreds of sites, provides such a setting, without engineered geometries, lattice-scale textures, or long-range hoppings. Exact nesting reduces the problem, independently at each transverse momentum $k_y$, to a $1+1$ dimensional Dirac Hamiltonian with a position-dependent mass: every simple zero of $m(x)$ binds Jackiw-Rebbi zero modes, and the two walls of a period form an effective Su-Schrieffer-Heeger ring. The model interpolates between a chirally pinned flat band at large $L$, a helical miniband whose nodes are enforced by a boundary phase of the ring, and a bias-dimerized regime in which the sign of the bias sets a winding number. A central result is that the miniband bandwidth is not a single scale: a max-min measurement conflates three widths of different origin, the helical height $W_{\rm JR}$ exponential in the period, the zone-edge upturn $W_{\rm edge}\propto L^{-2/3}$ dominating at large $L$, and a bias bump exponential in $L$, so the flat band is robust against bias in the thermodynamic limit. We analyze two lattice realizations, a two-orbital model with modulated inter-orbital hybridization and a single-orbital bond-order texture sharing the nodal physics while leaving the van Hove points gapless, and propose experiments on cold-atom superlattices, Kekule-ordered graphene, STM designer lattices, and microwave arrays.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅含慢调制狄拉克质量纹理的方格点阵模型，经精确嵌套在每个横向动量ky下化为1+1维变质量狄拉克哈密顿量，从而在一个可精确求解且易于实验实现的平台上统一平带与拓扑束缚态。
AI.motivation: 平带能放大相互作用产生关联相，拓扑束缚态在原理上稳健，但把二者结合到一个既可精确解析又便于实验实现的模型中一直很困难（通常需人工几何、格点尺度纹理或长程跃迁）。
AI.method: 方格点阵上引入慢调制狄拉克质量 m(x)=m+m0 cos(2πx/L)（L 可达数百格点）。利用精确嵌套，问题按横向动量ky解耦为1+1维位置依赖质量的狄拉克方程；m(x) 的每个单零点束缚 Jackiw-Rebbi 零模，一个周期两侧的壁构成有效 SSH 环。并分析两种格点实现：双轨道调制杂化模型，以及单轨道键序纹理。
AI.result: 模型可在大L下从手征钉扎平带，经由环边界相位固定节点的螺旋微带，过渡到偏压二聚化区（偏压符号定义绕数）。关键结论：微带带宽并非单一尺度——最大-最小测量混叠了三种不同来源宽度：螺旋高度W_JR随周期指数变化、区边翘起W_edge∝L^{-2/3}在大L下主导、偏压隆起对L指数变化；故热力学极限下平带对偏压稳健。单轨道实现保持节点物理但范霍夫点保持无能隙。
AI.conclusion: 该慢调制质量纹理模型为平带与拓扑零模的统一提供了可解析、可实验的框架，并澄清了平带带宽的多尺度本质；提出在冷原子超晶格、Kekule有序石墨烯、STM设计点阵与微波阵列上进行验证。

title: Spiral Edge States in Topological 2D Sb2Te3 Crystals
summary: This work explores the edge state conduction properties of twinned and spiraled, 2D Sb2Te3 topological insulator crystals. We show the structure supports spatially continuous edge states within two spiral and knotted edge conduction channels. The channels are connected through a topological defect. This geometry introduces boundary conditions into the 2D crystal that modifies the edge state dispersion. Using a combination of low loss Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy, Magnetic Force Microscopy and traditional carrier transport measurements we identify a distinct excitation at 0.155 eV in the spiral that seems to be related to two isolated states within the gap. This state is localized to the crystal edges. The modification of edge state bands using manipulation of a systems quantum geometry may open new avenues for the use of 2D topological systems.

AI.tldr: 研究孪晶与螺旋状二维Sb2Te3拓扑绝缘体晶体的边缘态导电性，发现两条螺旋与打结的边缘导电通道经拓扑缺陷连通，并在0.155 eV处观察到与带内两个孤立态相关的局域激发。
AI.motivation: 探究晶体几何（孪晶、螺旋、拓扑缺陷）带来的边界条件如何改变二维拓扑绝缘体的边缘态色散，从而为调控边缘态能带提供新途径。
AI.method: 以孪晶和螺旋状二维Sb2Te3拓扑绝缘体晶体为研究对象，结合低损耗电子能量损失谱（EELS）、磁力显微镜（MFM）与常规载流子输运测量进行表征。
AI.result: 结构支持在两条螺旋且打结的边缘通道内形成空间连续的边缘态，通道通过一个拓扑缺陷相连；在螺旋结构中识别出0.155 eV处的独特激发，可能对应于带隙内两个孤立态，且该态局域于晶体边缘。
AI.conclusion: 通过操纵体系的量子几何可修改边缘态能带，这为二维拓扑体系的应用开辟了新途径。

title: Organisation and aggregation of calcium carbonate ions in water via molecular simulation
summary: Crystallisation of calcium carbonate (CaCO$_3$) in aqueous solutions is essential for carbon dioxide sequestration and the sustainable production of calcium carbonate materials, which are widely used in industry and increasingly explored for novel applications. While crystallisation is often analysed within the framework of classical nucleation theory, CaCO$_3$ and other ionic crystals often form through amorphous precursor phases, motivating the need for alternative descriptions. In this work, we investigate the relationship between the formation of the first CaCO$_3$ coordination sphere, a fundamental unit of local ordering, and ionic aggregation using two complementary simulation approaches: on-the-fly probability-enhanced sampling (OPES) and asynchronous and infinite-swap replica exchange transition interface sampling ($\infty$RETIS). OPES was used to explore free-energy landscapes, whereas $\infty$RETIS was used to determine reaction kinetics. We studied systems at two levels of supersaturation, between which the formation of the first coordination sphere exhibited distinct kinetic behaviour. These differences were found to be linked to concentration-dependent ionic aggregation. At lower concentration, aggregation remains limited, whereas higher concentration promotes extensive spinodal-like aggregation. For both concentrations, the first coordination sphere forms within the pre-formed clusters through one of two distinct pathways: either within a cluster close to the minimum size required for its formation, or within larger amorphous aggregates whose size and structure depend on concentration. The coexistence of these pathways at both levels of supersaturation reveals the multifaceted nature of early-stage CaCO$_3$ crystallisation and highlights the importance of differentiating ionic aggregation and organisation.

AI.tldr: 本文以两种互补模拟方法（OPES与∞RETIS）研究CaCO₃首个配位球的形成与离子聚集的关系，发现高/低过饱和下存在不同动力学行为，且配位球通过两条不同路径在预形成团簇中生成。
AI.motivation: CaCO₃结晶常经无定形前驱相而非经典成核理论路径，需替代性描述；早期局部有序（首个配位球）形成与离子聚集的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用两种模拟：（1）OPES（on-the-fly probability-enhanced sampling）探索自由能景观；（2）∞RETIS（异步无限交换副本交换过渡界面抽样）计算反应动力学；在两种过饱和水平下比较。
AI.result: 两种过饱和度下首个配位球形成动力学不同，差异与浓度依赖的离子聚集相关：低浓度聚集有限，高浓度出现广泛的自旋odal式（spinodal-like）聚集；两浓度下配位球均在预形成团簇内通过两条路径形成——接近最小形成尺寸的小团簇内，或更大无定形聚集体内（其尺寸与结构随浓度变化）。
AI.conclusion: 早期CaCO₃结晶具多面性，两种过饱和度下路径共存，强调区分"离子聚集"与"离子组织"的重要性。

title: Dispersion of low-energy optical excitations in NiPS$_3$ explained by singlet polaron theory
summary: Optical and resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) experiments in the van der Waals antiferromagnet NiPS$_3$ have revealed narrow excitonic resonances near 1.5 eV whose microscopic origin remains under debate. In this work we study the momentum dependence of these excitations using the singlet-polaron theory (SPT) previously developed for NiPS$_3$. Within its framework, we calculate the spectral function of the corresponding effective model and extract the dispersion of the resulting quasiparticles. The theory naturally predicts two singlet excitations whose dynamics arise from their propagation in the zig-zag antiferromagnetic background ($S=1$) coupled to two-magnon processes. We show that the dispersion of the lowest-energy quasiparticle agrees very well with the excitonic dispersion measured by RIXS, reproducing both its overall shape and bandwidth along high-symmetry directions of the Brillouin zone. Our results provide a consistent interpretation of the optical excitations in terms of dispersive singlet polarons, and suggest that similar mechanisms may govern excitonic dynamics in other layered van der Waals antiferromagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文用单态极化子理论（SPT）计算NiPS3中~1.5 eV激子的动量依赖，所得最低能准粒子色散与RIXS测量的激子色散高度吻合（形状与带宽），将光学激发解释为可色散的单态极化子。
AI.motivation: NiPS3的光学与RIXS实验观测到~1.5 eV的窄激子共振，但其微观起源仍有争议；特别是这些激发的动量依赖（色散）尚缺乏理论解释。
AI.method: 在先前为NiPS3建立的单态极化子理论框架内，构建有效模型并计算其谱函数，从中提取准粒子色散。理论自然给出两个单态激发，其动力学源于在S=1锯齿形反铁磁背景中传播并与双磁振子过程耦合。
AI.result: 最低能准粒子的色散与RIXS测得的激子色散吻合很好，沿布里渊区高对称方向的整体形状与带宽均被复现；理论自然预言两个单态激发。
AI.conclusion: 结果为NiPS3的光学激发提供了自洽解释——色散型单态极化子，并提示类似机制可能主导其他层状范德华反铁磁体中的激子动力学。

title: Spatial interference changes the symmetry class of a Josephson element
summary: Spatial interference can break the inversion symmetry of an effective Josephson potential even in a laterally homogeneous junction with inversion-symmetric local energy. We derive a general criterion based on harmonic-dependent complex spatial form factors: a single local harmonic remains a shifted cosine, whereas multiple harmonics can acquire phases incompatible with any common inversion center, permitting cubic interactions and three-wave mixing. Phase reflection reverses all odd-order expansion coefficients about corresponding minima while preserving the even-order ones. For a capacitively shunted junction at fixed charging energy and arbitrary offset charge, it also preserves the complete quantum spectrum, enabling reversal of the odd nonlinear sector without spectral retuning. A centered cross junction with multiple local harmonics is one concrete example. Within the imposed-field model, a three-component magnetic field can generate an inversion-asymmetric effective potential, and reversing an odd number of field components exactly reflects it without changing the quantum spectrum of the capacitively shunted junction.

AI.tldr: 空间干涉可在横向均匀、局域能量反演对称的结中破坏有效约瑟夫森势的反演对称性；多谐波相位不相容导致立方相互作用与三波混频，相位反射可翻转奇阶非线性而不改变量子谱，并可由磁场分量反转实现。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为，只要结在横向均匀且局域能量具有反演对称性，有效约瑟夫森势就应保持反演对称。作者希望厘清空间干涉如何在何种条件下破坏这一对称性，并找到无需重新调节光谱即可翻转奇阶（如三波混频）非线性的机制。
AI.method: 引入谐波依赖的复空间形状因子，推导反演对称性保持与否的判据；分析单谐波与多谐波情形；定义"相位反射"操作，研究其对奇/偶阶展开系数及电容旁路结量子谱的影响；以中心交叉结和在施加磁场模型下的三分量磁场为例进行具体构造验证。
AI.result: 单个局域谐波仍只给出平移余弦势；当多个谐波的相位无法共享同一反演中心时，势变为反演不对称，可产生立方相互作用与三波混频。相位反射会关于相应极小值翻转所有奇阶系数而保留偶阶系数；对固定充电能、任意偏置电荷的电容旁路结，相位反射保持完整量子谱不变。中心交叉结即在施加场模型下，三分量磁场可生成反演不对称有效势，反转奇数个场分量即可精确实现反射且不改变量子谱。
AI.conclusion: 反演对称性破缺源于多谐波空间形状因子的相对相位而非局域能量本身；相位反射提供了一种在不改变量子谱的前提下翻转奇阶非线性的手段，并可由磁场分量反转物理实现，对可调三波混频等量子器件设计有直接意义。

title: UGME: A python package for non-Markovian protein folding dynamics
summary: Biomolecular processes, including protein folding, protein-protein association, and protein-DNA recognition, often occur on timescales beyond what individual atomistic molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can reach. To access these longer-timescale dynamics, practitioners commonly combine many parallelized, short trajectories into reduced kinetic models, such as Markov state models (MSMs), that describe how the biomolecules interconvert between a handful of biomolecular configurations (e.g., folded and unfolded states of a protein). Central to MSM construction is the assumption that, at sufficiently long time lags, these projected dynamics become memoryless, such that the future evolution of the system depends only on its current state. Yet, projecting high-dimensional biomolecular dynamics onto a small set of states necessarily discards information about unresolved degrees of freedom, including solvent reorganization, side-chain rearrangements, and intermediate configurations. Because these unresolved motions can continue to influence subsequent dynamics, the resulting dynamics retain memory that is absent from a Markovian description. Here, we present ugme, a modular, open-source Python package for constructing and validating generalized master equations (GME) models that explicitly account for these non-Markovian (memory) effects.

AI.tldr: ugme是一个模块化开源Python包，用于构建和验证广义主方程（GME）模型，以显式刻画分子动力学降维投影中出现的非马尔可夫（记忆）效应。
AI.motivation: 单条原子级分子动力学（MD）模拟难以覆盖蛋白折叠、蛋白-蛋白结合、蛋白-DNA识别等长时标过程。常用做法是把大量并行短轨迹汇总为马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）。但MSM依赖"足够长滞后时间后投影动力学无记忆"的假设，而将高维动力学投影到少量状态必然丢弃溶剂重组、侧链重排、中间构象等未解析自由度，这些运动持续影响后续演化，使真实动力学保留马尔可夫描述所缺失的记忆。
AI.method: 提出ugme——一个模块化、开源的Python软件包，用于构建与验证广义主方程（GME）模型，从而显式纳入非马尔可夫（记忆）效应；通过将记忆核纳入动力学描述来克服MSM的无记忆假设（摘要未展开具体算法与模块细节）。
AI.result: 摘要主要介绍工具本身，未给出定量实验数据；其预期价值在于提供可构建并验证GME模型的统一软件框架，弥补MSM忽略记忆项的不足。
AI.conclusion: ugme为生物分子长时标动力学提供了一个开源、可扩展的工具，使研究者能够在降维动力学模型中显式处理未解析自由度带来的记忆效应，是对常规MSM分析范式的补充与推广（具体性能与案例有待全文验证）。

title: Pressure-Driven Evolution of the Physical Properties of Layered Y2GaB and Y2InB MAB Phases: A Comparative First-Principles Study
summary: MAB phases are nanolaminated ternary borides in which strong in-plane M-B bonds and weaker interlayer interactions drive their distinctive stability and functionality. Hydrostatic pressure offers a direct route to tune the in-plane and interlayer interactions that govern the stability and functionality of layered Y2GaB and Y2InB borides. Here, first-principles calculations are used to compare their structural, elastic, thermophysical, electronic, bonding, optical, and vibrational responses from 0 to 20 GPa. Elastic criteria show that Y2GaB is stable at 0, 5, and 10 GPa, whereas Y2InB is stable only at ambient pressure. Within the stable Y2GaB range, compression increases the elastic moduli, acoustic velocities, Debye temperature, and lattice thermal conductivity while reducing the elastic anisotropy. Both compounds are multiband metals and spin-orbit coupling modifies local dispersions without opening a gap. Y2GaB retains nine Fermi-surface sheets from 0 to 10 GPa, whereas Y2InB has eight at ambient pressure, with no pressure-induced topological reconstruction. Charge-density and overlap analyses indicate mixed ionic-covalent Y-B bonding within a delocalized metallic background. Optical parameters are anisotropic. Unit-cell phonon spectra contain positive frequencies at 0 and 10 GPa, although expanded-supercell calculations reveal low-frequency sensitivity. These results establish mechanically viable pressure windows and clarify substitution-driven structure-property relationships for these borides.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理计算比较了层状MAB相硼化物Y2GaB与Y2InB在0–20 GPa静水压下的结构与性能响应，确认Y2GaB在0–10 GPa力学稳定、Y2InB仅常压稳定，并揭示压力可调控弹性、热输运与光学各向异性。
AI.motivation: MAB相硼化物由强面内M-B键与较弱层间作用构成，二者的平衡决定其稳定性与功能。静水压是调控这两类相互作用的直接手段，但Y2GaB、Y2InB的压致响应及Ga/In替代带来的结构-性能关系尚缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，在0–20 GPa范围内系统比较Y2GaB和Y2InB的结构、弹性、热物理、电子结构、成键、光学与振动性质；用弹性判据确定力学稳定区间，结合电荷密度与重叠分析判断成键特征，并考察自旋轨道耦合影响及单胞/扩胞声子谱。
AI.result: Y2GaB在0、5、10 GPa满足弹性稳定判据，Y2InB仅常压稳定。稳定区间内加压使Y2GaB弹性模量、声速、德拜温度与晶格热导率升高、弹性各向异性降低。两者均为多带金属，SOC仅改变局部色散而不开带隙；Y2GaB在0–10 GPa保持9个费米面片，Y2InB常压为8个，无压致拓扑重构。Y-B为离子-共价混合键，处于离域金属背景中；光学参数各向异性。单胞声子谱在0与10 GPa均为正频，但扩胞计算显示对低频敏感。
AI.conclusion: 研究界定了两种硼化物的力学可用压力窗口，并阐明Ga→In替代驱动的结构-性能关系，为层状MAB相硼化物的压力工程与成分设计提供依据。

title: Wilson-loop formulations of the spin polarization and the spin Chern number
summary: In this paper, we derive the spin polarization and the spin Chern number in momentum and real spaces in terms of the Wilson loop in each spin sector. For these derivations, the spin matrix in the subspace of occupied or unoccupied states is generalized by the unitary rotation to prevent the spectral gap from closing. In the presence of a finite spin gap, the spin eigenvectors recompose the eigenstates of the Hamiltonian in two spin sectors. A dimensional reduction leads to the charge polarization in each spin sector in terms of the Wilson loop along the effective Brillouin zone (BZ) in one dimension (1D). A linear combination of the charge polarizations defines the spin polarization, which naturally quantifies the spin Chern number in momentum space. It is also shown that the spin Chern number is directly derived from the local Wilson loops on a discrete 2D BZ. The theoretical treatment is further generalized for real space in a supercell framework, which can deal with ordered and disordered systems in a unified manner. In this framework, the spin Chern number in real space is formulated in terms of the Wilson loop around the BZ boundary. These formulations are used to numerically evaluate topological phases in the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model. Numerical results show an equivalence of the spin Chern number and the ${\mathbb{Z}_2}$ index.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Wilson loop从动量空间和实空间推导自旋极化与自旋Chern数，并证明其与Z2指标等价。
AI.motivation: 需要在统一框架下（动量空间与实空间、有序与无序体系）刻画拓扑相，并厘清自旋Chern数与Z2指标之间的关系。
AI.method: 通过对占据/非占据子空间中自旋矩阵施加酉旋转以避免谱隙闭合；利用自旋本征矢重构两个自旋扇区的哈密顿量本征态；经维度约化用沿有效布里渊区（1D）的Wilson loop表示各自旋扇区的电荷极化，其线性组合给出自旋极化并自然量化自旋Chern数；进一步在离散2D BZ上用局域Wilson loop直接导出该数，并推广到超胞实空间框架（统一下处理有序与无序体系），以绕BZ边界的Wilson loop表述实空间自旋Chern数。
AI.result: 在BHZ模型的数值计算中，自旋Chern数与Z2指标表现出等价性。
AI.conclusion: 所提Wilson loop方法为动量空间与实空间中的自旋Chern数提供了统一且可数值实施的表述，并验证其与Z2拓扑指标一致。

title: Investigation on Thermal Stability of Epi-GeSn Directly on Si (001)
summary: In this paper we investigate the structural properties and thermal stability of metastable Ge1-xSnx epilayers (~4.5 at.% Sn) grown directly on Si(001) substrates by high-resolution X-ray diffraction (HRXRD) and Raman spectroscopy. Our results demonstrate that both 70 and 140 nm films are fully relaxed, with the thicker film exhibiting a small tensile strain (+0.09%). The thermal stability of the heterostructures was evaluated up to 813 K using temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy and scanning electron microscopy. The surface-weighted Raman response (532 nm excitation) and surface morphology of the 70 nm film remain highly stable. In contrast, the 140 nm film undergoes severe degradation, characterized by significant attenuation and broadening of the Ge-Ge longitudinal optical phonon mode, alongside enhanced surface Sn segregation. These findings demonstrate that the thermal stability of direct GeSn/Si heterostructures is governed by the initial defect structure established during epitaxial growth, providing key design rules for understanding the fabrication of GeSn-based optoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 研究直接在Si(001)上外延的亚稳态Ge1-xSnx(~4.5% Sn)薄层的结构与热稳定性：70nm薄膜热稳定，140nm薄膜在加热至813K时显著退化，热稳定性取决于生长时形成的初始缺陷结构。
AI.motivation: GeSn合金是Si基光电器件的关键材料，但亚稳态GeSn/Si异质结在热过程中的稳定性及内在机制尚不清楚，需要明确影响热稳定性的结构因素以指导器件制备。
AI.method: 采用高分辨X射线衍射(HRXRD)和拉曼光谱表征直接在Si(001)上生长的70nm与140nm Ge1-xSnx外延层的结构与应变；用变温拉曼光谱(532nm激发，表面敏感)和扫描电子显微镜在至813K范围内评估热稳定性。
AI.result: 两种厚度薄膜均完全弛豫，较厚的140nm膜存在+0.09%的微小拉伸应变。70nm膜的拉曼响应与表面形貌高度稳定；140nm膜则严重退化，表现为Ge-Ge纵向光学声子模的显著衰减与展宽，并伴随表面Sn偏析增强。
AI.conclusion: 直接GeSn/Si异质结构的热稳定性由外延生长过程中形成的初始缺陷结构所决定，这为GeSn基光电器件的设计与制造提供了关键指导原则。

title: Molecular-Dynamics Verification of Effective Gravity under Heat Conduction
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Two supplemental movies are provided as ancillary files
summary: We test the effective-gravity prediction of global thermodynamics using standard molecular dynamics of a two-dimensional Lennard-Jones fluid. Under weak heat conduction with the lower boundary hotter than the upper boundary, the transition between liquid below gas and liquid above gas shifts from zero to finite downward gravity. Using independently measured equilibrium saturation pressures, we calculate the shift predicted by global thermodynamics and find agreement with the observed transition shift. The transition occurs at zero effective gravity, where the hydrostatic pressure difference balances the saturation-pressure difference between the two boundaries. The hysteresis response under heat conduction also agrees with the equilibrium response when plotted against effective gravity. These results establish the predictive power of global thermodynamics for nonequilibrium structure formation.

AI.tldr: 通过二维Lennard-Jones流体的分子动力学模拟，验证了全局热力学对有效重力的预测：在弱热传导下液-气分层翻转发生在零有效重力处，且与平衡态饱和蒸气压差预测一致。
AI.motivation: 检验"全局热力学"理论能否在非平衡条件下预测结构形成（液气分层的翻转），此前缺乏直接的分子动力学验证。
AI.method: 对二维Lennard-Jones流体做标准分子动力学模拟，施加弱热传导且下边界温度高于上边界；改变向下重力强度，观察"液体在下/气体在上"与"气体在上"分层构型的转变；独立测量平衡态饱和蒸气压，用全局热力学计算转变点的预测位移，并比较热传导下滞回行为与平衡响应。
AI.result: 分层转变从零重力移到有限向下重力处；由饱和蒸气压差计算的预测转变位移与模拟观测一致；转变发生在有效重力为零处，此时静水压差与上下边界饱和蒸气压差平衡；滞回响应在以有效重力为横轴时与平衡响应一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了全局热力学对非平衡结构形成的预测能力。

title: Matrix-product-state GPLHR for non-Hermitian many-body eigenproblems
summary: Computing multiple eigenstates of non-Hermitian many-body operators plays an important role in investigating excitation spectra, spectral properties, and relaxation dynamics in interacting and open quantum systems. However, this task is challenging because the eigenvectors are generally nonorthogonal and the Hilbert space dimension grows exponentially with system size. Here, we formulate the generalized preconditioned locally harmonic residual (GPLHR) method in a matrix product state (MPS) framework to efficiently compute multiple targeted right eigenstates whose eigenvalues lie near a specified shift in the complex plane. Successive randomized compression (SRC) is employed to accelerate operator applications. We test the method on transcorrelated and complex Hubbard chains, an interacting non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain, and a Liouvillian model. The results demonstrate that GPLHR combined with MPS provides an efficient and accurate approach for computing multiple eigenstates of non-Hermitian many-body operators.

AI.tldr: 将 GPLHR 方法嵌入 MPS 框架，高效计算非厄米多体算符在复平面上给定偏移附近的多个右本征态。
AI.motivation: 非厄米多体算符的多本征态对研究激发谱、谱性质和弛豫动力学至关重要，但本征向量非正交且希尔伯特空间维度指数增长，计算困难。
AI.method: 将广义预处理局部调和残差（GPLHR）方法推广到矩阵乘积态（MPS）框架，求指定复偏移附近的多个目标右本征态；并用连续随机压缩（SRC）加速算符作用。
AI.result: 在转相关与复数 Hubbard 链、相互作用非厄米 SSH 链及 Liouvillian 模型上测试，结果显示 GPLHR+MPS 可高效、准确地计算多个非厄米多体本征态。
AI.conclusion: GPLHR 与 MPS 结合为求解非厄米多体算符的多个本征态提供了高效精确的途径。

title: Pressure Evolution of the Superconducting Order Parameter of Kagome Superconductor CsV3Sb5
summary: Kagome superconductors AV3Sb5 (A = K, Rb, Cs) offer an outstanding platform for exploring the interplay among charge-density-wave (CDW) order, superconductivity (SC), and nontrivial topological electronic states. For CsV3Sb5, moderate hydrostatic pressure induces a double-dome superconducting phase diagram while monotonically suppressing the CDW phase, which signals an unconventional coupling between SC and CDW. Nevertheless, the microscopic nature of the pressure-modulated superconducting state and its relationship with CDW order remain poorly understood. Here we employ soft directional point-contact spectroscopy (SDPCS), combined with superconducting resistive measurements, to probe the superconducting order parameter of CsV3Sb5 under hydrostatic compression. Our anisotropic PCAR measurements resolve two distinct s-wave superconducting gaps along the c-axis and a strongly anisotropic gap within the ab plane. Two-band Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk (BTK) fits to the c-axis spectra yield a large gap satisfying 2Delta1/kBTc > 3.52 and a small gap with 2Deltas/kBTc < 3.52. The spectral-weight-averaged coupling ratio 2Deltaavg/kBTc is enhanced in the pressure window between P1 and P2, suggesting that pressure-induced modifications of the low-energy electronic structure may contribute to the evolution of superconductivity. For ab-plane junctions, the superconducting gap anisotropy is gradually suppressed above P1, accompanied by the emergence of a pronounced peak-dip-hump structure suggestive of enhanced coupling between superconducting quasiparticles and a bosonic excitation. These results shed new light on the intricate entanglement between CDW and SC in kagome superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 通过软点接触谱(SDPCS)结合电阻测量，研究CsV3Sb5在静水压下的超导能隙结构，发现c轴两个s波能隙、ab面强各向异性能隙，且2Δavg/kBTc在P1-P2压力窗口增强，指示CDW与SC的复杂纠缠。
AI.motivation: CsV3Sb5在静水压下呈现双穹顶超导相图并单调抑制CDW，暗示SC与CDW存在非常规耦合，但压力调控下超导态的微观本质及其与CDW的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用软定向点接触谱(SDPCS)结合超导电阻测量，在静水压下探测CsV3Sb5的超导序参量；用双带Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk(BTK)模型拟合c轴谱，并分析ab面结的各向异性。
AI.result: c轴方向分辨出两个s波能隙：大能隙2Δ1/kBTc>3.52，小能隙2Δs/kBTc<3.52；ab面存在强各向异性能隙。谱重平均耦合比2Δavg/kBTc在P1与P2之间增强。ab面能隙各向异性在P1以上逐渐被抑制，并出现明显的峰-谷-峰结构，暗示准粒子与玻色激发耦合增强。
AI.conclusion: 压力诱导的低能电子结构改变可能驱动超导电性演化，结果揭示了笼目超导体中CDW与超导之间的复杂纠缠关系。

title: Learning Electron Density with Virtual Atoms for Transferable Atomistic Representations
summary: Electron density is a fundamental quantity of electronic structure, yet most machine learning density models treat it solely as a reconstruction target and are developed separately from machine learning interatomic potentials. Here, we introduce a virtual-atom formulation within the DPA3 framework, in which density query points are represented as virtual nodes and processed by the same parameterized encoder used for real atoms. An asymmetric neighbor construction allows virtual atoms to receive information from nearby real atoms without altering the real-atom interaction graph. The resulting framework supports density, energy, and force prediction through task-specific readout heads. The proposed model achieves state-of-the-art density reconstruction accuracy on the Materials Project benchmark, matches the best reported performance on nickel-manganese-cobalt battery cathode materials, and is competitive with dedicated density models on QM9. When density labels are used jointly with energy and force supervision, the model improves in-domain accuracy, makes local environment information more accessible under linear probing, and reduces zero-shot force errors on larger QM40 molecules. Density-only checkpoints also provide useful initializations for downstream energy-force learning under the fixed fine-tuning protocol. Together, these results support electron density as a source of electronic-structure supervision for interatomic-potential representations.

AI.tldr: 在DPA3框架中引入"虚拟原子"表示电子密度的查询点，使其与真实原子共享同一编码器，从而统一实现密度、能量与力的多任务预测，并证明电子密度可作为势函数表示的有效监督信号。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习密度模型大多仅把电子密度当作重构目标，且与机器学习原子间势（MLIP）分开开发，割裂了密度与能量/力的关联。作者希望把电子密度作为电子结构监督信号，融入势函数表示学习之中。
AI.method: 在DPA3中把密度查询点建模为虚拟节点，用与真实原子相同的参数化编码器处理；采用非对称邻居构建，让虚拟原子从邻近真实原子获取信息但不改变真实原子间交互图；通过任务特定的readout头分别输出密度、能量和力。
AI.result: 在Materials Project基准上取得SOTA密度重构精度，在NMC电池正极材料上匹配已报道最佳性能，在QM9上与专用密度模型相当；密度与能量/力联合监督可在域内提升精度、线性探测下更易获取局域环境信息、并在更大的QM40分子上降低零样本力误差；仅密度预训练权重也能为下游能量-力学习提供有效初始化。
AI.conclusion: 统一框架表明电子密度是一种可用的电子结构监督来源，可增强原子间势表示的质量与泛化能力。

title: EpNet-Si: Atomic Form Factors Learned from Band Structures
summary: The empirical pseudopotential method (EPM) computes band structures with one diagonalization per $k$ point and no self-consistency, but its fixed atomic form factors do not transfer between crystal structures. To address this limitation, we introduce EpNet-Si, an EPM for silicon in which an equivariant network predicts each atom's plane-wave form factor from its local environment: a species potential plus monopole, dipole and quadrupole corrections, mixed by a learned router over atomic densities, together with an $s/p$ nonlocal projector. With 6{,}195 parameters, the model is trained through the eigensolver on reference density functional theory (DFT) band energies of only 77 cells. Among 231 distortions of the trained structure types, the 142 gapped cells have mean band and gap errors of 15 and 8\,meV; among 192 unseen structures, the 165 gapped cells have mean errors of 38 and 49\,meV. Physical properties derived from EpNet-Si, including effective masses, gap pressure coefficients, deformation potentials and the density of states at the Fermi level, agree with those obtained from the reference DFT calculations. These results suggest that the classical EPM, fitted to a small set of reference data, can be extended into a fast alternative for modern electronic band-structure calculations.

AI.tldr: 提出EpNet-Si，用等变网络从局部环境预测原子平面波形因子，把经典经验赝势法扩展为可跨结构迁移的快速能带计算方法。
AI.motivation: 经验赝势法（EPM）每个k点只需一次对角化、无需自洽，速度快；但其固定的原子形状因子无法在不同晶体结构之间迁移，限制了通用性。
AI.method: 构建EpNet-Si：等变网络为每个原子预测平面波形因子，包括种类势能加单极、偶极、四极修正，用基于原子密度的学习型路由器混合，并加入s/p非局域投影算符。仅6195参数，通过本征求解器端到端训练，参考数据为77个晶胞的DFT能带能量。
AI.result: 在训练结构类型的231个畸变中，142个有带隙晶胞的平均能带/带隙误差为15/8 meV；192个未见结构中165个有带隙晶胞的平均误差为38/49 meV。有效质量、带隙压力系数、形变势及费米能级处态密度等派生性质与参考DFT一致。
AI.conclusion: 少量参考数据拟合下的经典EPM可被扩展为现代电子能带计算的快速替代方案。

title: Symmetry Condition and Mechanism for the Anomalous Hall Effect in Odd-Parity Magnets
summary: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in unconventional magnets has attracted considerable attention. A giant AHE has recently been observed in the candidate $p$-wave magnet Gd$_3$(Ru$_{1-δ}$Rh$_δ$)$_4$Al$_{12}$ [Nature 646, 837(2025)], while its theoretical interpretation invokes a spontaneous magnetization to break time-reversal symmetry ($\mathcal{T}$), although the magnetic order itself already breaks $\mathcal{T}$. Consequently, the microscopic origin of the AHE in odd-parity magnets (OPMs) remains an open question. Here we establish the symmetry condition and microscopic mechanism for the AHE in OPMs. Since the OPM order is classified by the spin group whereas the AHE is governed by the magnetic group, the AHE is allowed only when the magnetic point group is ferromagnetic; conversely, it is forbidden whenever the effective time reversal $\mathcal{T}τ$ (with $τ$ a fractional translation), which is essential to the realization of the OPM, is preserved. Microscopically, OPMs generically host a hidden Zeeman field (HZF) rooted in this intrinsic $\mathcal{T}$ breaking, and its interplay with spin-orbit coupling (SOC) generates the AHE without any external field. We demonstrate this picture with models on the square, honeycomb, and kagome lattices. In particular, a square-lattice helimagnet with sublattice-resolved SOC maps exactly onto an anisotropic Rashba--Zeeman model, whose Zeeman term is nothing but the HZF and directly yields the AHE. Our results establish the symmetry condition for the AHE in OPMs and identify the HZF--SOC interplay as a general route to realize it.

AI.tldr: 该文确立了奇宇称磁体(OPM)中反常霍尔效应(AHE)的对称性条件与微观机制：AHE仅在磁点群为铁磁型时允许，其微观来源是OPM固有的"隐藏塞曼场"(HZF)与自旋轨道耦合的协同作用。
AI.motivation: 候选p波磁体Gd3(Ru1-δRhδ)4Al12中观测到巨大AHE，但既有理论归因于"自发磁化破坏时间反演"，而磁序本身已破坏T，解释不自洽；OPM中AHE的微观起源仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 基于自旋群与磁群的对称性分析，给出AHE允许/禁止判据；提出由内禀T破缺产生的隐藏塞曼场(HZF)与SOC耦合机制，并在正方、蜂窝、kagome晶格模型上验证；证明子格分辨SOC的正方晶格螺旋磁体精确映射为各向异性Rashba–Zeeman模型。
AI.result: AHE仅当磁点群为铁磁型时才允许；当有效时间反演Tτ（τ为分数平移）保持时AHE被禁止。正方晶格的映射中Zeeman项即HZF，直接给出AHE；三类晶格模型均复现该机制。
AI.conclusion: 确立了OPM中AHE的对称性判据，并将HZF–SOC协同识别为实现AHE的一般途径。

title: DiffGA: Steering Frozen Diffusion Models for Materials Design via Evolutionary Search
summary: Steering candidate generation toward user-defined objectives is central to inverse materials design, yet remains difficult when objectives are black-box, changing, or non-differentiable, as in many simulation- and experiment-derived properties. Generative models offer a solution but typically require retraining or fine-tuning for each new objective, demanding labeled data and substantial compute, or rely on differentiable guidance that is brittle to gradient noise and undefined for many practical targets. We present DiffGA, a retraining-free framework that injects evolutionary search into the sampling trajectory of a retrained diffusion model, evolving partially denoised states under an arbitrary black-box oracle. Because oracle evaluation often dominates campaign cost, we couple DiffGA with an on-the-fly Bayesian surrogate that reuses representations from state-of-the-art machine-learned force fields (MLFFs). A Gaussian process is fit during the campaign on the force fields's graph embeddings and, once it demonstrably ranks an unseen generation, replaces expensive property evaluations under an uncertainty-aware acquisition rule, reducing oracle cost with negligible loss of accuracy. Across three crystal-design tasks using a frozen MatterGen backbone, DiffGA outperforms diffusion-only, compute-matched, purely evolutionary, and fine-tuned baselines in oracle-assessed rates of stable, unique, and novel hits. Rather than proposing scientific compounds, we use density functional theory to quantify MLFF oracle fidelity, showing that it is a faithful proxy in key regimes but systematically biased in others, delineating when proxy-driven generative discovery can be trusted. On a representative sample, DiffGA's top hits survive first principles re-evaluation as physically realistic hits, while the surrogate-accelerated pipeline preserves this fidelity at a fraction of the cost.

AI.tldr: DiffGA：在预训练扩散模型采样轨迹中注入进化搜索，实现免重训练的逆材料设计，并用MLFF表征驱动的GP代理降低黑箱oracle成本。
AI.motivation: 逆材料设计中目标常为黑箱、非可微、动态变化（如模拟/实验属性），现有生成模型需针对每个新目标重训练/微调（耗数据与算力），或依赖脆弱且对许多目标无定义的可微引导；同时oracle评估主导实验成本。
AI.method: 将进化搜索嵌入扩散采样过程，在任意黑箱oracle下对部分去噪状态进行演化；并耦合在线贝叶斯代理：在MLFF图嵌入上拟合高斯过程，当其能可靠排序未见生成样本时，以不确定性感知的采集规则替代昂贵性质评估。以冻结的MatterGen为骨干，在三个晶体设计任务上评测，并用DFT检验MLFF oracle保真度。
AI.result: 在oracle评估的稳定、独特、新颖命中率上，DiffGA优于纯扩散、等算力、纯进化和微调基线；代理加速在显著降低oracle成本的同时几乎不损失精度。DFT显示MLFF在部分区域是可靠代理但在其他区域存在系统性偏差；抽样中DiffGA的顶级命中经第一性原理复评仍为物理上真实的命中。
AI.conclusion: DiffGA提供免重训练、面向黑箱目标的扩散生成框架，并明确界定代理驱动生成式发现的可信边界；论文侧重方法学验证而非提出具体新化合物。

title: Charge-selective topological locking and ultraslow coarsening in magnetoelastic media
comment: 7 pages + 3 figures (main text), and 14 pages + 2 movies (supplemental material)
summary: We demonstrate that the symmetry of magnetoelastic coupling governs the topological organization of composite defects and can qualitatively alter phase-ordering kinetics. In a two-dimensional theory of an in-plane magnetic vector coupled to elastic strain, we find that integer magnetic vortices bind pairs of elementary elastic half-defects. Isotropic magnetostriction produces a core-induced elastic winding independent of the magnetic charge, giving defect binding without charge locking and leaving the magnetic sector with essentially XY-like coarsening. In contrast, quadrupolar magnetoelastic coupling locks magnetic and elastic defect charges: continuous rotational symmetry favors $q_φ=q_θ$, whereas crystalline anisotropy can reverse the locking to $q_φ=-q_θ$. We reveal that both locking sectors display anomalously slow vortex annihilation: defect density shows a power-law decay $t^{-2/5}$, while the average defect-velocity scales as $t^{-4/5}$. These results are consistent with a dynamic exponent $z\simeq 5$. We show that this coarsening slowdown is associated with large anisotropic elastic friction. An adiabatic elimination of the elastic field reveals that isotropic magnetostriction merely renormalizes local magnetic interactions, whereas orientational coupling induces effective nonlocal interactions between magnetic spins. Our experimentally testable results thus establish magnetoelastic coupling symmetry as a means of controlling defect topology and ordering kinetics.

AI.tldr: 磁弹耦合的对称性决定复合缺陷的拓扑组织，并能定性改变相序化动力学：各向同性磁致伸缩给出XY类粗化，而四极磁弹耦合锁定磁/弹缺陷电荷，导致反常慢的涡旋湮灭（密度t^{-2/5}，速度t^{-4/5}，z≈5）。
AI.motivation: 探究磁弹耦合的对称性如何影响缺陷拓扑组织与相序化动力学，特别是缺陷电荷锁定机制以及粗化速率的调控。
AI.method: 在二维平面内磁矢量耦合弹性应变的模型中，分析整数磁涡旋与基本弹性半缺陷的束缚；比较各向同性磁致伸缩与四极磁弹耦合下的电荷锁定情况；通过绝热消去弹性场，考察有效磁相互作用（局域重整化 vs 非局域耦合）。
AI.result: 各向同性磁致伸缩产生与磁荷无关的芯致弹性绕数，缺陷束缚但不锁定电荷，磁扇区保持近似XY行为；四极耦合锁定缺陷电荷，连续旋转对称下q_φ=q_θ，晶体各向异性可反转为q_φ=-q_θ。两种锁定扇区均出现缺陷密度t^{-2/5}、平均缺陷速度t^{-4/5}的反常慢湮灭，对应动态指数z≈5，与大的各向异性弹性摩擦相关。
AI.conclusion: 磁弹耦合对称性是控制缺陷拓扑与序化动力学的有效手段，预测结果可实验检验。

title: Dynamical chiral symmetry breaking in rotating QED$_3$: critical flavor number and the occupation-reweighting channel
summary: We study dynamical chiral symmetry breaking in $(2{+}1)$-dimensional QED on a rigidly rotating disc, $ΩR<1$, within the rainbow Schwinger--Dyson framework. At zero temperature the rotation response of the condensate vanishes identically, so $N_c^{\rm SD}(Ω,T{=}0)=N_c^{\rm SD}(0)=2.60\pm0.01$ (using three operational definitions). At finite temperature, rotation suppresses the condensate through a dominant occupation-reweighting channel, $\hatκ_{\rm occ}=-1.55$, accounting for $\ge 99.995\%$ of the linearized total response at the reference parameters, with self-consistent feedback amplifying it by $26.5$. The screening channel is reported at fixed regularization, $\hatκ_{\rm scr}(\varepsilon = 0.01)=-0.97$; its $\varepsilon \to 0$ behavior is logarithmically divergent. The crossover flavor $N^{*}(Ω)$ falls monotonically at fixed temperature (a corollary). The critical flavor number is unchanged by rotation at $T=0$ (theorem). Together these results set the finite-temperature reference for the model.

AI.tldr: 在刚体旋转圆盘上的(2+1)维QED中，用rainbow Schwinger–Dyson框架研究动力学手征对称破缺：零温下旋转对凝聚的响应恒为零，临界味数保持不变；有限温下旋转通过占据重加权通道强烈抑制凝聚。
AI.motivation: 探究旋转（转动参考系）是否以及如何影响(2+1)维QED中的动力学手征对称破缺与临界味数，为有限温情形建立基准。
AI.method: 在ΩR<1的刚体旋转圆盘几何下，采用rainbow Schwinger–Dyson方程，并用三种操作定义计算临界味数N_c^SD；将旋转响应线性分解为占据重加权通道与屏蔽通道，考察正则化依赖及自洽反馈放大效应。
AI.result: T=0时凝聚的旋转响应严格为零，N_c^SD(Ω,0)=N_c^SD(0)=2.60±0.01；有限温下占据重加权通道主导（κ̂_occ=-1.55，占线性化总响应≥99.995%，自洽反馈放大26.5倍）；屏蔽通道在固定正则化下κ̂_scr(ε=0.01)=-0.97，ε→0时对数发散；交叉味数N*(Ω)在固定温度下单调下降。
AI.conclusion: 零温临界味数是旋转不变的（定理），旋转效应仅在有限温出现并以占据重加权为主；这些结果为该模型建立了有限温参考基准。

title: Photon echo from Maki-Thompson interference in a fluctuating s-wave superconductor
summary: We study theoretically the nonlinear optical response of a fluctuating s-wave superconductor driven by two successive terahertz pulses. We show that the response exhibits a photon echo signal that arises from the quantum interference between the time-reversed electron and hole trajectories in the Maki-Thompson process. By contrast, the transport of the fluctuating Cooper pairs responsible for the Aslamazov-Larkin conductivity does not generate an echo. The photon echo signal can be readily measured using terahertz two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy, highlighting its potential to distinguish different fluctuation conductivity mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究了由两个连续太赫兹脉冲驱动的涨落s波超导体的非线性光学响应，发现Maki-Thompson过程中的时间反演电子-空穴轨迹量子干涉会产生光子回波信号，而Aslamazov-Larkin过程不产生回波，可用于区分不同的涨落电导机制。
AI.motivation: 涨落超导体中存在Maki-Thompson与Aslamazov-Larkin两种不同的涨落电导机制，但缺乏能够实验上区分二者的清晰判据；本文旨在寻找可辨识这两类机制的非线性光学特征。
AI.method: 采用理论方法分析涨落s波超导体在双太赫兹脉冲驱动下的非线性光学响应，考察Maki-Thompson过程（时间反演电子与空穴轨迹的量子干涉）与Aslamazov-Larkin过程（涨落库珀对输运）对响应的贡献，并结合太赫兹二维相干光谱学进行讨论。
AI.result: 响应中出现光子回波信号，源于Maki-Thompson过程中时间反演电子与空穴轨迹的量子干涉；而由Aslamazov-Larkin电导所对应的涨落库珀对输运不产生回波。
AI.conclusion: 光子回波信号可通过太赫兹二维相干光谱学方便地测量，为区分不同涨落电导机制提供了有力的光谱学手段。

title: Tersoff-NN: Hybrid Machine-Learned Bond-Order Extension of the Tersoff Potential
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures. Supplementary material is included as an ancillary PDF (21 pages). Minor correction to the Acknowledgments. Scientific content unchanged
summary: Accurate, robust, and efficient interatomic potentials are highly desirable for large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. Although machine-learning interatomic potentials can reproduce first-principles potential-energy surfaces with high accuracy, they typically incur higher computational costs than conventional empirical potentials and may be less reliable outside their training domains. We developed Tersoff-NN, a hybrid machine-learning potential for Si, which retains the analytical radial interactions and cutoff structure of the Tersoff potential while representing its environment-dependent bond-order factor using compact neural networks (NNs). Benchmarks for 32,768-atom systems show that Tersoff-NN is 4-12 times faster than the Behler-Parrinello-type NN potentials tested in this study. Tersoff-NN improves the short-range structure of liquid Si relative to the conventional Tersoff potential, closely reproduces the ab initio radial and angular distributions, and reproduces the equilibrium structure of diamond Si and qualitative energetic trends among several crystalline phases. Furthermore, melt-quench simulations reveal a disordered solid with predominantly four-coordinated, tetrahedral-like local environments. Additionally, characteristic reconstruction motifs are retained on Si surfaces despite their exclusion from the training dataset. A direct comparison with an alternative atom-centered bond-order NN highlights the critical role of physical constraints in ensuring dynamic stability. Despite exhibiting comparable validation errors, the selected triplet-based architecture remains stable, while an alternative model exhibits unphysical bond-order growth and atomic collapse. These results confirm that learning only the bond-order term improves the description of diverse Si environments while retaining substantial computational efficiency and enhancing dynamical stability.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 Tersoff-NN：保留 Tersoff 势的解析径向项与截断结构，仅用紧凑神经网络表示环境依赖的键序因子，从而在保持高效与稳定性的同时超越经验势精度。
AI.motivation: 大规模 MD 需要准确、稳健且高效的原位势。机器学习势虽能高精度复现第一性原理势能面，但计算开销通常高于经验势，且在训练域外可靠性差；因此希望兼顾经验势的物理形式与 ML 的精度。
AI.method: 构建 Si 的混合势 Tersoff-NN：沿用 Tersoff 的解析径向相互作用与截断结构，仅将键序项用小型神经网络（基于三元组/原子中心架构）参数化；在 32768 原子体系上基准测试，并与 Behler-Parrinello 型 NN 势及其他原子中心键序 NN 对比，评估液态 Si 结构、金刚石与晶相能量趋势、熔淬非晶及表面重构。
AI.result: 在 32768 原子体系上比所测 BP 型 NN 势快 4–12 倍；相较传统 Tersoff 改善了液态 Si 的短程结构，接近从头算的径向与角向分布；复现金刚石 Si 平衡结构与多晶相能量趋势的定性规律；熔淬得到以四配位四面体类局域环境为主的无序固体；训练集未包含的表面仍保留特征重构基元。对比中，三元组架构在验证误差相当的情况下保持动力学稳定，而替代模型出现非物理键序增长与原子坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 仅学习键序项即可显著改善对 Si 多种环境的描述，同时保留较高的计算效率并增强动力学稳定性；物理约束（解析径向形式与截断）对保证动态稳定性至关重要。

title: SIREN: A nonlinear Rankine-source boundary element solver for the stationary motion of a marine vehicle in calm water
summary: SIREN (Ship Inviscid Resistance and Elevation eNgine) is a Rankine-source panel solver for the steady wave resistance of a ship, in the tradition of Dawson's method. The free-surface condition is linearised about a base flow, and the linearisation is iterated. In the present formulation the base flow is the solution of a Neumann problem on the actual boundary: sources on the entire hull, wet and dry, and on the free surface panels, with impermeability imposed on both, so that the free surface acts as a rigid lid at the position it currently occupies. This replaces the classical double-body flow, whose image about z=0 is meaningful only for a flat surface and a hull cut at z=0, and it removes the need for desingularised free-surface panels. In the non-linear iteration the free-surface panels are moved rigidly in the vertical to the relaxed wave elevation at their centroid, the hull panels are marked wet or dry against the moved surface, and the base flow is recomputed on the moved geometry; impermeability applies to the whole hull regardless of this marking, which is used only to select which panels enter the force integral, and under-relaxation is confined to the passes where the non-linear correction accumulates without being reset. The radiation condition is imposed by a one-row upstream shift of the collocation points, and the wave resistance is obtained by pressure integration and, independently, by transverse wave-cut analysis.

AI.tldr: SIREN是一个基于Rankine源面元法的船舶稳态兴波阻力求解器，沿用Dawson方法传统。它在真实边界（干湿船体+自由面）上求解Neumann问题作为基流，取代经典双体流，并通过迭代线性化实现非线性自由面。阻力由压力积分与横切波分析两种独立方法获得，结果一致。
AI.motivation: 经典Dawson方法的双体流基流依赖关于z=0的镜像，仅在平自由面和z=0处切分的船体下有意义，且需要去奇异化的自由面面元。作者希望提出一种在真实边界上建立的基流，避免镜像假设和去奇异化需求，同时能够自然处理非线性自由面与干湿船体划分。
AI.method: 自由面条件围绕基流线性化并迭代。基流为实际边界上的Neumann问题解：源布置于整个船体（湿与干）及自由面面元，两者均施加不可穿透条件，使自由面充当当前位置的刚性盖。非线性迭代中，自由面面元按其形心处松弛波高刚性垂直移动，船体面元相对移动后的水面标记干湿，并在移动后的几何上重算基流；不可穿透施加于整个船体，标记仅用于选取进入力积分的面元；欠松弛仅用于非线性修正累积且不被重置的迭代。辐射条件通过配置点单行上游移动施加，阻力由压力积分和横切波分析独立求得。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量数值结果。方法层面：基流在真实边界上求解，消除了对镜像与去奇异化自由面面元的需求；干湿标记与不可穿透条件解耦；非线性迭代可处理松弛波面；阻力经压力积分与横切波分析两种独立途径获得以相互验证。
AI.conclusion: SIREN提供了一种不依赖双体流镜像假设的Rankine源兴波阻力求解框架，通过在真实几何上迭代求解基流并刚性移动自由面面元，统一处理非线性自由面与干湿船体，辐射条件以配置点上游移位实现，阻力以两种独立方法求取。

title: Graphene-Confined Growth of Few-Layer PtSe2 via One-Step Selenization
summary: Platinum diselenide (PtSe$_2$), a member of the transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) family, is a promising material for next-generation electronic and optoelectronic applications due to its thickness-dependent properties, transitioning from semimetallic in bulk to semiconducting behavior at the few-layer limit. However, the scalable fabrication of large-area ultrathin PtSe$_2$ films remains challenging, as conventional selenization of pre-deposited Pt layers often leads to undesired three-dimensional clustered growth. This work explores a novel strategy for promoting two-dimensional growth of PtSe$_2$ by employing a graphene-mediated confinement approach. The method involves coating a Pt layer with graphene oxide (GO), followed by annealing in a selenium atmosphere, which results in the simultaneous formation of PtSe$_2$ and the reduction of GO to graphene. The graphene overlayer acts as a physical confinement layer, suppressing vertical growth and enabling the synthesis of graphene-confined PtSe$_2$ heterostructures on centimetre-scale substrates and promoting lateral connectivity of PtSe$_2$ regions observed by STEM. Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), including temperature-resolved in situ atomic-resolution measurements, was used to investigate the influence of selenization temperature on the growth mechanism and structural evolution of PtSe$_2$ films. The results show that graphene confinement stabilizes lateral growth and promotes the formation of few-layer films with improved structural ordering. Beyond PtSe$_2$, this graphene-assisted approach provides a general strategy for fabricating and stabilizing ultrathin TMD layers, including those prone to environmental degradation, providing a new outlook for enabling detailed studies of their intrinsic properties.

AI.tldr: 利用氧化石墨烯覆盖层作为物理限域层，在硒化过程中抑制PtSe₂的垂直团簇生长、促进二维横向生长，实现厘米级超薄PtSe₂/石墨烯异质结构的可控制备。
AI.motivation: PtSe₂随厚度变化从半金属过渡到半导体，是下一代电子与光电器件的潜力材料，但传统"预沉积Pt层+硒化"方法易导致三维团簇状生长，难以规模化制备大面积超薄薄膜。
AI.method: 在Pt层上涂覆氧化石墨烯(GO)后进行硒气氛退火，使PtSe₂形成与GO还原为石墨烯同时发生；石墨烯覆盖层作为物理限域层抑制纵向生长。采用STEM（含温度分辨原位原子级成像）研究硒化温度对生长机制与结构演化的影响。
AI.result: 在厘米级衬底上合成石墨烯限域的PtSe₂异质结构，STEM观察到PtSe₂区域的横向连通性增强；石墨烯限域稳定了横向生长，促进具有更好结构有序性的少层薄膜形成。
AI.conclusion: 石墨烯辅助限域是一种通用策略，可制备并稳定超薄TMD层（包括易环境降解的材料），为研究其本征性质提供新途径。

title: Emergence of Nonlocal Hydrodynamics in Many-Body Radiative Heat Transport
summary: We develop a nonlocal hydrodynamic theory of radiative heat transport in many-body systems by coarse graining their microscopic electrodynamic interactions. Long-range radiative exchange naturally generates a spatially nonlocal constitutive relation in which the heat current at a given position depends on temperature gradients over an extended region, while energy conservation retains its local conservative form. Fourier transport emerges as a controlled long-wavelength limit when the interaction kernel has a finite second spatial moment. When this moment fails to converge, spatial nonlocality survives coarse graining and gives rise to non-Fourier transport. The resulting framework establishes a systematic bridge between discrete many-body fluctuational electrodynamics and a continuous description of radiative heat transport.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对多体系统微观电动力学相互作用做粗粒化，建立了一个辐射热输运的非局域流体动力学理论，并揭示Fourier定律只在核函数二阶空间矩有限时作为长波极限出现，否则表现为非Fourier输运。
AI.motivation: 多体辐射热交换由长程相互作用主导，其离散微观图像与连续介质中常用的局域Fourier热传导描述之间存在鸿沟，缺乏系统性的桥梁。
AI.method: 从离散多体涨落电动力学出发进行粗粒化：能量守恒保持局域保守形式，而热流与温度梯度的关系导出为含空间核的卷积型非局域本构关系，并分析其长波极限与核函数空间矩的性质。
AI.result: 当相互作用核具有有限的二阶空间矩时，Fourier输运作为受控的长波极限出现；当二阶矩不收敛时，非局域性在粗粒化后依然保留，从而产生非Fourier输运。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在离散多体涨落电动力学与连续辐射热输运描述之间建立了系统对应，为判定Fourier型与非Fourier型辐射热传导提供了判据。

title: Role of defect trapping in the enhanced corrosion resistance of Ni-Mo alloys with yttrium and yttrium oxide additions
summary: Corrosion of structural alloys remains a critical challenge for advanced molten salt reactors, where aggressive fluoride salts promote continuous dissolution at the salt-metal interface. While most mitigation strategies emphasize thermodynamic stability, kinetic control of atomic transport has received comparatively less attention. Here, we propose a corrosion mitigation strategy based on diffusion control and vacancy trapping by dilute yttrium (Y) solutes and yttrium oxide (Y$_2$O$_3$) dispersions in Ni alloys. A combined computational and experimental approach integrates density functional theory (DFT), self-consistent mean-field (SCMF) diffusion modeling, and an impurity trapping model to quantify the impact of defect trapping on effective vacancy mobility. Strong first-nearest-neighbor vacancy-Y binding, off-lattice vacancy configurations, and elevated rotational and dissociation barriers result in pronounced suppression of vacancy diffusivity, while Y$_2$O$_3$-associated sites treated as fixed traps in the model further reduce the mobile vacancy population. Ni-Mo (NM), Y-modified (NMY), and Y$_2$O$_3$-containing (NMYO) alloys were tested in molten fluoride salt at 750°C. Corrosion penetration decreases systematically from NM to NMY to NMYO, consistent with the predicted reduction in vacancy-mediated transport. The same trend is observed in mass change, with net weight loss decreasing from 0.52% for NM to 0.23% for NMY and 0.09% for NMYO. These results are consistent with an alloy-side transport contribution from defect trapping and reduced atomic transport. This study therefore suggests point defect engineering as a promising alloy design strategy for extreme nuclear environments.

AI.tldr: 该文提出通过稀Y溶质与Y₂O₃弥散相捕获空位、抑制扩散来减缓Ni合金在熔盐中的腐蚀，并用DFT+SCMF计算与750°C熔盐实验证实NM→NMY→NMYO腐蚀逐级减轻。
AI.motivation: 先进熔盐堆中氟盐对结构合金的持续溶解腐蚀严重，现有缓解策略多聚焦热力学稳定性，而原子输运的动力学控制（尤其空位介导的合金侧输运）研究不足。
AI.method: 结合DFT、自洽平均场（SCMF）扩散模型与杂质捕获模型，量化Y/Y₂O₃缺陷捕获对有效空位迁移率的影响；并对Ni-Mo（NM）、Y改性（NMY）、含Y₂O₃（NMYO）三种合金在750°C氟盐中进行腐蚀实验验证。
AI.result: Y与空位存在强第一近邻结合、离格空位构型及升高的旋转/解离势垒，显著抑制空位扩散；Y₂O₃位点作为固定陷阱进一步降低可动空位数量。腐蚀深度按NM>NMY>NMYO递减，失重由0.52%（NM）降至0.23%（NMY）和0.09%（NMYO），与预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持缺陷捕获导致合金侧原子输运降低是腐蚀减轻的重要机制，点缺陷工程可作为极端核环境下合金设计的有效策略。

title: Macroscopic fluctuation theory of stochastic systems undergoing monitoring
summary: We develop a macroscopic fluctuation theory for diffusive classical lattice gases subject to continuous coarse-grained monitoring. Treating measurements in the typical-outcome (quenched) regime, we show that observation adds a quadratic confining term to the MFT action that pins the density to its hydrodynamic profile. We derive sufficient conditions under which, in the presence of monitoring, the current large-deviation function remains convex, the additivity principle holds, and dynamical phase transitions are excluded. For particle-hole-symmetric one-dimensional models we find that monitoring suppresses dynamical phase transitions and can change their order from second to first, as we demonstrate in the Katz--Lebowitz--Spohn model. In the strong-measurement limit, we find that the current distribution becomes Gaussian and determine the scaling of its cumulants: they follow simple power laws when the mobility remains nonzero throughout the system, but exhibit anomalous logarithmic scaling when the mobility vanishes at the boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文为受连续粗粒化监测的经典扩散晶格气体建立了宏观涨落理论（MFT），揭示监测在MFT作用量中引入二次约束项，并系统分析了其对电流大偏差性质、动力学相变以及强监测极限的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统宏观涨落理论描述晶格气体中的涨落与电流大偏差，但实际观测总是连续的、粗粒化的。测量会改变系统涨落统计，作者希望理解在典型结果（淬火）观测体制下，连续监测如何改变扩散晶格气体的宏观涨落结构与动力学相变。
AI.method: 在经典扩散晶格气体上发展带连续粗粒化监测的宏观涨落理论；将测量处理为典型结果（quenched）体制，推导监测对MFT作用量的贡献并给出电流大偏差函数保持凸性、加性原理成立且排除动力学相变的充分条件；对粒子-空穴对称的一维模型（以Katz–Lebowitz–Spohn模型为例）作具体分析，并研究强测量极限下电流分布及累积量标度。
AI.result: 观测在MFT作用量中添加二次约束项，把密度钉在其流体力学剖面上；给出监测下电流大偏差函数保持凸性、加性原理成立、无动力学相变的充分条件；对PHS一维模型，监测可抑制动力学相变、并可能使其从二阶变为一阶（KLS模型中得到验证）；强监测极限下电流分布趋于高斯，累积量在迁移率处处非零时满足幂律，在边界处迁移率消失时呈现反常对数标度。
AI.conclusion: 连续监测从根本上改变扩散晶格气体的宏观涨落统计：它加强约束、抑制动力学相变并可改变其阶数，同时使强监测下的电流统计高斯化并呈现依赖于迁移率结构的标度行为。

title: Realistic Simulation of Valence-band Photoemission Spectra by using First-principles Calculations on the Basis of FLAPW Method
summary: In order to reproduce experimental photoemission spectroscopy (PES) data by using band structure calculations with linearized augmented-plane-wave method, we developed a new method to calculate the atomic-subshell photoelectron differential cross section (PE-DCS) of the valence band. PE-DCS was calculated to be the sum of the products of the partial density of states (PDOS) and the photoionization differential cross section (PI-DCS) of each atomic subshell. To construct an appropriate PDOS beyond the conventional muffin-tin sphere (MTS) PDOS, we proposed a ``nearly-neutral atomic sphere", which can be defined as a natural extension of MTS. Although the calculational method for atomic-subshell PI-DCS was the standard Hartree-Fock-Slater method, we developed a new computer code in order to deal with the unoccupied electron shells in the ground state of isolated atoms up to $\sim$10 keV. Details of the PE-DCS calculations were examined by using two simple examples of Na metal and NaCl, and then, the method was applied to hard x-ray PES (HX-PES) data of CuAlO$_2$. The experimental spectra were satisfactorily reproduced, demonstrating the potential applications of our method to HX-PES spectra of many compounds.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于能带计算（LAPW）的原子亚壳层光电子微分截面（PE-DCS）新方法，用PDOS与PI-DCS乘积之和再现PES谱，并用Na、NaCl及CuAlO2的HX-PES数据验证。
AI.motivation: 实验光电子能谱（PES）需借助能带结构计算来解释，但传统muffin-tin球（MTS）PDOS不足以正确描述价带PE-DCS，因此需要新的PDOS构建方式与PI-DCS计算方案。
AI.method: 将PE-DCS表示为各原子亚壳层PDOS与光离子化微分截面（PI-DCS）乘积之和；提出“近中性原子球”作为MTS的自然扩展以构建更合适的PDOS；PI-DCS采用标准Hartree-Fock-Slater方法，并新开发计算代码以处理孤立原子基态未占据电子壳层（能量至约10 keV）。
AI.result: 以Na金属和NaCl两个简单体系检验PE-DCS计算细节，随后将方法应用于CuAlO2的硬X射线光电子能谱（HX-PES）数据，实验谱得到满意再现。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效再现HX-PES谱，显示出在多化合物硬X射线光电子能谱分析中的潜在应用价值。

title: Molecule-intercalated van der Waals Josephson junctions uncover complex multiband superconductivity
summary: Intercalation of molecular species provides a route to tailor the electronic structure in van der Waals superconductors, yet intercalated compounds have rarely been integrated into phase-sensitive quantum devices. Here, we realize hybrid molecular Josephson junctions based on TaS2/NbSe2 heterostructures. Selective intercalation of the TaS2 electrode induces monolayer-like Ising superconductivity, while the junctions exhibit asymmetric Fraunhofer interference, field-induced and spontaneous Josephson diode effects. The zero-field diode disappears upon reversing the electrode stacking and re-emerges after intercalating the lower NbSe2 electrode. These findings indicate that the hybrid superconducting electrode hosts unconventional superconductivity underlying the nonreciprocal transport, while molecular intercalation acts as a tuning knob for its internal phase structure. This behavior is consistent with a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking multiband superconducting state characterized by a nontrivial relative phase between superconducting condensates. Our results establish hybrid molecular Josephson junctions as a quantum-device platform for phase-sensitive investigation and integration of molecularly engineered superconductors, opening opportunities to uncover and engineer unconventional superconducting phases.

AI.tldr: 基于TaS2/NbSe2异质结的分子插层Josephson结，观测到不对称Fraunhofer干涉、场致与自发Josephson二极管效应，指向时间反演对称破缺的多带超导态。
AI.motivation: 分子插层可调控范德华超导体电子结构，但插层化合物极少被集成到相敏量子器件中；作者希望用Josephson结作为相敏探针，研究插层诱导的非常规超导及内部相位结构。
AI.method: 制备TaS2/NbSe2异质结Josephson结，对TaS2电极选择性插层（诱导类单层Ising超导）；测量磁场下的Fraunhofer干涉图样与零场/场致非互易（二极管）效应，并通过对调电极堆叠顺序、插层下层NbSe2电极进行对照实验。
AI.result: 观察到不对称Fraunhofer干涉、场致及自发Josephson二极管效应；零场二极管在对调堆叠顺序后消失，插层下方NbSe2电极后重新出现，说明非互易输运源自杂化超导电极的非常规超导性，分子插层可调控其内部相位结构。
AI.conclusion: 结果与时间反演对称破缺、超导凝聚体间具非平庸相对相位的多带超导态一致；杂化分子Josephson结可作为相敏量子器件平台，用于研究并集成分子工程超导体，探索与调控非常规超导相。

title: Kernel-Level Constant-Potential Molecular Dynamics in GROMACS
summary: How charge rearranges within an electrode shapes the behavior of batteries, supercapacitors, and other electrochemical devices. Molecular simulations can capture this response by allowing the charge on each electrode atom to adjust to its surroundings, but repeatedly calculating these charges adds substantial computational cost. We present an open-source implementation of the constant-potential method in GROMACS that integrates these calculations into the program's optimized CPU and GPU routines. Comparisons with established codes validate the electrode charges, while charging, voltammetry, and impedance simulations demonstrate the response to changing electrical conditions. The implementation also supports electrodes that move or deform and models of finite metallic screening and electron spillover. In a pair of charged carbon nanotubes, allowing charge to move away from the facing surfaces reduces the repulsive force at contact by about half at an intermediate charge and keeps the pair bound where a uniform-charge model opens within the simulated time. These capabilities make the electrical response of electrodes accessible within GROMACS for studies of interfacial structure, charging dynamics, and electrode motion.

AI.tldr: 本文在GROMACS中开源实现了恒电势方法，将电极原子电荷的动态计算集成到CPU与GPU优化例程中，从而低成本地模拟电极电荷重排及其电化学响应。
AI.motivation: 电极内电荷重排决定电池、超级电容器等电化学器件行为。分子模拟需让每个电极原子电荷随环境调整，但反复计算电荷带来巨大计算开销，需高效实现。
AI.method: 在GROMACS中开源实现恒电势方法，把电荷计算整合进其优化的CPU和GPU例程；支持可移动/形变电极、有限金属屏蔽与电子溢出的建模。通过与其他成熟代码对比验证电极电荷，并用充电、伏安、阻抗模拟检验响应。
AI.result: 电极电荷与已有代码吻合；充电、伏安和阻抗模拟展现对电学条件变化的响应。一对带电碳纳米管中，允许电荷远离相对表面可使中间电荷下接触排斥力约减半，并在均匀电荷模型会分离的时间尺度内保持结合。
AI.conclusion: 该实现使电极电学响应分析可在GROMACS中进行，可用于界面结构、充电动力学和电极运动研究。

title: A Gauge-Inspired Coupled Fokker--Planck System for Multistate Stochastic Dynamics: Formalism and 1-D Numerical Implementation
summary: Extending the Fokker--Planck equation to a coupled system of equations through non-Abelian symmetry groups offers a powerful theoretical framework for coupled multi-state stochastic systems. However, translating this abstract gauge field formulation into viable numerical predictions remains an unaddressed challenge. Motivated by our previous work on ice crystal habit evolution, in this work we bridge this gap by presenting the first numerical solver for an SU(2) gauge-coupled Fokker--Planck system in (1+1) dimensions. Using an operator-splitting scheme combined with a non-oscillatory advection solver, our algorithm strictly ensures probability conservation, non-negativity, and numerical stability. We demonstrate that non-Abelian gauge coupling acts as a cross-reactive feedback loop that fundamentally alters system dynamics, driving continuous probability exchange between states, suppressing localised density peaks, and forcing long-time spatial delocalisation. Validated across linear and quadratic coupling regimes up to strong interactions (g <= 1.0), this work establishes the foundational computational infrastructure needed to integrate complex multi-state physics. Overall, while our approach provides a key step toward improving ice cloud representation in atmospheric and climate models, the underlying physical framework and computational engine remain fundamentally general and multidisciplinary, offering a versatile paradigm for any domain requiring coupled multi-state stochastic equations.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为SU(2)规范耦合的Fokker–Planck系统 (1+1维) 构建数值求解器，采用算子分裂与非振荡对流格式保证概率守恒、非负性与稳定性，揭示非阿贝尔规范耦合会形成交叉反馈回路，导致状态间持续概率交换、抑制局部峰值并迫使长期空间离域。
AI.motivation: 将Fokker–Planck方程借非阿贝尔对称群推广为耦合方程组，为多态随机系统提供强理论框架，但这种抽象规范场表述缺乏可行的数值预测手段，该方法学空白尚未被解决；作者受此前冰晶习性演化工作启发，希望弥合此差距。
AI.method: 提出首个针对 (1+1) 维SU(2)规范耦合Fokker–Planck系统的数值求解器：采用算子分裂（operator-splitting）方案结合非振荡对流求解器（non-oscillatory advection solver），严格保证概率守恒、密度非负与数值稳定性；在线性与二次耦合机制、直至强相互作用 (g ≤ 1.0) 范围内进行验证。
AI.result: 非阿贝尔规范耦合表现为一种交叉反应式反馈回路，从根本上改变系统动力学：驱动状态间连续的概率交换，抑制局部密度峰，并迫使长时间尺度上的空间离域；求解器在线性与二次耦合及强相互作用区间均通过验证。
AI.conclusion: 本工作建立了整合复杂多态物理所需的基础计算设施；虽以改进大气与气候模式中冰云表征为动机，但其物理框架与计算引擎本质上是通用的、跨学科的，可为任何需要耦合多态随机方程的领域提供通用范式。

title: Interfacial Coupling Reshapes Nonlinear Polarization in a Spin-Defect van der Waals Heterostructure
summary: Van der Waals heterostructures offer a direct route to couple an optically active layer to a two-dimensional spin sensor, yet their coherent nonlinear response at interfaces remains poorly resolved. Here, we use polarization-resolved second harmonic-generation imaging to resolve four distinct regions of a hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) -based heterostructure, native hBN, neutron-irradiated hBN containing negatively charged boron vacancies (VB-), PbI2 and their complete overlap. The detected intensity scales quadratically with incident power, consistent with a dominant second-order optical process. Polarization scans show that adding PbI2 transforms the distorted VB- SHG anisotropy into a predominantly fourfold response with a sixfold stronger SHG than native hBN alone. This non-additive nonlinear response occurs in the same layer architecture also shown to enhance defect photoluminescence, linking spin-defect sensitization to an interface-modified effective second-order susceptibility.

AI.tldr: 利用偏振分辨二次谐波成像，在 hBN/PbI₂ 异质结中观测到缺陷非线性响应的非加和增强。
AI.motivation: 范德华异质结可将光学活性层与二维自旋传感器耦合，但其界面处的相干非线性响应尚未被清晰解析。
AI.method: 采用偏振分辨二次谐波产生（SHG）成像，分辨 hBN 基异质结的四个区域：原生 hBN、含负电硼空位（V<sub>B</sub><sup>−</sup>）的中子辐照 hBN、PbI₂ 以及二者完全重叠区；并做功率依赖与偏振扫描分析。
AI.result: SHG 强度随入射功率二次方增长，表明二阶光学过程占主导；叠加 PbI₂ 后，V<sub>B</sub><sup>−</sup> 的畸变各向异性转变为以四重对称为主，且 SHG 强度比单独原生 hBN 高约六倍。该非加和响应与同一层结构中缺陷光致发光的增强同时出现。
AI.conclusion: 界面修饰的有效二阶极化率可将自旋缺陷敏化与非线性光学响应联系起来，为非加和界面非线性提供依据。

title: Probing quantum nonlinear phononics in multilayer graphene with time-resolved Raman scattering
summary: Coherently driven phonons are conventionally described classically. Nonlinear phonon-phonon interactions, however, allow an infrared drive to reshape the fluctuation spectrum and generate substantial nonthermal enhancement of phonon fluctuations, motivating a description beyond the coherent displacement alone. We benchmark classical and semiclassical approximations against the full quantum theory and find that the semiclassical treatment substantially improves agreement with the quantum dynamics. We propose nonequilibrium spontaneous Raman scattering as a sensitive probe of these effects and apply our framework to recent experiments suggesting quantum nonlinear phononics involving the $\mathrm{E}_{1u}$ and $\mathrm{E}_{2g}$ modes in multilayer graphene. At very strong pump fields, driving the $\mathrm{E}_{1u}$ mode significantly modifies the $\mathrm{E}_{2g}$ Raman spectrum; however, reproducing the reported response at experimental field strengths requires accounting for pump-induced Raman matrix element dynamics or alternative energy pathways into the $\mathrm{E}_{2g}$ mode. Our findings extend nonlinear phononics beyond average atomic displacements to the dynamics of lattice fluctuations, highlighting the interplay between coherent motion and quantum correlations in driven materials.

AI.tldr: 本文比较经典、半经典与完整量子理论，说明半经典方法能更好刻画驱动声子的量子涨落，并提出非平衡自发拉曼散射作为探测量子非线性声子学的灵敏手段。
AI.motivation: 相干驱动声子通常用经典描述，但非线性声子-声子相互作用可使红外驱动重塑涨落谱并显著非热增强声子涨落，仅用相干位移不足以描述，需要超越经典的框架。
AI.method: 将经典与半经典近似同完整量子理论基准对比，提出非平衡自发拉曼散射作为探针，并把框架应用于多层石墨烯中 E1u 与 E2g 模的量子非线性声子学实验。
AI.result: 半经典处理与量子动力学符合度明显提升；极强泵浦下驱动 E1u 会显著改变 E2g 拉曼谱，但在实验场强下复现报道响应需考虑泵浦诱导的拉曼矩阵元动力学或通往 E2g 的其他能量通道。
AI.conclusion: 研究把非线性声子学从平均原子位移拓展到晶格涨落动力学，凸显驱动材料中相干运动与量子关联的相互作用。

title: Nucleation at the GST--oxide interface and beam-driven ordering in amorphous Ge--Sb--Te: HAADF, EDS and electron pair distribution functions across a 4D-STEM dose series
summary: Where crystal nuclei form in amorphous phase-change materials decides how they switch. We study six successive 4D-STEM scans, with simultaneous HAADF and EDS data, of a magnetron-sputtered Ge-Sb-Te (GST) film, restricted to the GST layer and its interface with the oxide beneath it. Nucleation sites do not differ in composition or number density: the nuclei lie on the same robust HAADF-EDS relation as the matrix, and at fixed HAADF the spread of the summed EDS signal equals its Poisson counting noise (ratio 1.03 +- 0.05). The nuclei are nevertheless crystalline and stand out in the 4D-STEM max-intensity virtual image (median z = 11.0) but not in HAADF (z = 1.3) or EDS (z = 0.3). We classify the film in four ways (HAADF intensity, I(q) phase mapping, PCA of the whole diffraction patterns and a self-supervised SimCLR encoder) and compare the electron pair distribution functions (PDFs) of all classes after calibrating reciprocal space on the Au cap. All bulk classes share one short-range structure (first shell 2.70-2.74 Å); towards the interface the first sharp diffraction peak (FSDP) moves to lower q, and every method isolates a thin interface-edge environment with a shorter or missing first shell. The I(q) classification isolates, in every scan, an interface environment that holds 62-100% of the nucleus pixels (1.2-2.5-fold above depth) and persists when the nucleus pixels are removed before classification. The interface, rather than a distinct composition or density of the nucleating volume, therefore marks where nuclei form. Over 4.7e3 e/Å^2 the HAADF signal falls by 17%, the first shell shortens by 0.03 Å and the FSDP narrows by 9%, apparently ordering the film as it damages it. All analyses used PySTEMLab, an interactive 4D-STEM analysis environment developed for this work.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过多次4D-STEM扫描（同时采集HAADF与EDS）研究磁控溅射GST薄膜中晶核的形成位置，发现晶核在成分与数密度上与基体无异，真正决定成核的是薄膜与下方氧化物的界面。
AI.motivation: 非晶相变材料中晶核形成的位置决定了器件如何开关，但成核究竟由成分、密度还是界面决定尚不清楚，需要高分辨的空间—成分—结构联合表征。
AI.method: 对六次连续的4D-STEM扫描（限定GST层及其与下方氧化物界面），同步获取HAADF与EDS数据；用四种方式分类薄膜（HAADF强度、I(q)相图、全衍射图PCA、自监督SimCLR编码器），并以Au帽层标定倒空间后比较各类的电子对分布函数（PDF）。
AI.result: 晶核与基体落在同一HAADF-EDS关系上，固定HAADF下EDS信号离散度等于泊松计数噪声（比值1.03±0.05），成分与数密度无差异；晶核在4D-STEM最大强度虚拟图中显著（中位z=11.0），而在HAADF(z=1.3)与EDS(z=0.3)中不显著。所有体相类别共享同一短程结构（第一壳层2.70–2.74 Å）；靠近界面FSDP向低q移动，各方法都识别出第一壳层更短或缺失的薄界面环境；I(q)分类在每次扫描中都分离出含62–100%晶核像素（高于深度维度1.2–2.5倍）的界面环境，且移除晶核像素后依然存在。随剂量增至4.7e3 e/Å²，HAADF下降17%、第一壳层缩短0.03 Å、FSDP变窄9%。
AI.conclusion: 晶核形成位置由界面（而非成核体积的独特成分或密度）决定；电子辐照在造成损伤的同时似乎使薄膜趋于有序。所有分析基于为本文开发的PySTEMLab交互式4D-STEM分析环境。

title: Exact Microscopic One-Body Reduction in the Symmetric Exclusion Process
summary: The symmetric exclusion process (SEP) is a paradigmatic model of interacting particle transport. Its current--density correlations are governed by an infinite many-body hierarchy of equations. Only recently, this hierarchy was found to collapse at large scales onto a single closed equation. Is this remarkable simplification created by coarse graining, or does it reflect a deeper property already present in the microscopic dynamics? Here we show that the second scenario is realized. At arbitrary time on the lattice, the entire hierarchy collapses onto a single linear equation which is exactly equivalent to a persistence problem for a single auxiliary random walker. Thus an interacting many-body problem reduces exactly to a genuine one-body problem before any scaling limit is taken. This reduction determines the complete finite-time correlation profile, including during nonequilibrium relaxation. More broadly, the microscopic operator uncovered here opens a route to more general correlation functions in the SEP, and may point to a general organizing principle for nonequilibrium interacting particle systems.

AI.tldr: 对称排他过程(SEP)的电流-密度关联层级在格点微观层面精确坍缩为单个线性方程，等价于单个辅助随机游走者的持久性问题。
AI.motivation: 此前发现SEP的无穷多体关联层级在大尺度下坍缩为单个闭合方程，但尚不清楚这种简化是粗粒化造成的，还是微观动力学本身已具备的更深层性质。作者要判定究竟是哪种情形。
AI.method: 在格点上、任意时刻直接分析关联层级，证明整个层级可坍缩为单个线性方程，并将该方程精确映射为单个辅助随机游走者的持久性(persistence)问题；未取任何标度极限。
AI.result: 第二种情形成立：多体关联层级在微观层面即精确坍缩，因此相互作用多体问题在取标度极限之前就严格约化为单体问题；由此可确定完整的有限时间关联剖面，包括非平衡弛豫过程。
AI.conclusion: 该约化揭示了SEP中隐藏的微观算符，为计算更一般的关联函数开辟途径，并可能指向非平衡相互作用粒子系统的一般组织原理。
