For two adjacent braid generators, a single projective exchange spectrum is insufficient: their relative eigenline geometry supplies an additional gauge-invariant modulus. On the generic irreducible two-channel branch, braid consistency locks these coordinates through an exact spectrum-geometry relation. Using Riesz projectors and Kato transport, we realize this geometry in a five-arm Kitaev-Majorana network and test spectral and relative-geometric responses in an independent two-dimensional four-vortex Kitaev model. Finite-time dynamics tests the exchange operation, microscopic fusion sewing tests its composition across fusion descriptions, and matched-spectrum controls isolate the role of relative geometry. Nonzero projective Kato curvature shows that braid-consistent, fusion-coherent exchange can depend on the control path. Non-Hermiticity thus exposes exchange geometry, braid consistency re-locks it, fusion coherence further constrains it, and projective flatness determines when geometric exchange becomes intrinsically topological.

AI.tldr: 本文将二维任意子交换统计推广到非厄米框架，提出"非厄米统计几何"理论：放松厄米性会把僵硬的编织/融合数据软化为复空间中的谱与相对几何自由度，并给出编织一致性锁定、融合缝合与几何曲率判据。
AI.motivation: 传统拓扑相中，微观交换几何被压缩为刚性的编织与融合数据，几何信息不可见；非厄米性可能将其重新释放出来，从而理解几何交换何时真正成为内禀拓扑量。
AI.method: 构建非厄米统计几何理论：对两个相邻编织生成元，除投影交换谱外引入相对本征线几何作为额外规范不变模量；在一般不可约双通道分支上用谱-几何精确关系与编织一致性锁定坐标；借助 Riesz 投影与 Kato 输运，在五臂 Kitaev-Majorana 网络中实现该几何，并在独立二维四涡旋 Kitaev 模型中检验谱与相对几何响应；用有限时间动力学、微观融合缝合及匹配谱对照分离相对几何作用。
AI.result: 出现非零投影 Kato 曲率，表明编织一致且融合相干的交换可依赖控制路径；匹配谱对照可隔离相对几何的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 非厄米性暴露交换几何，编织一致性重新锁定它，融合相干性进一步约束它，而投影平坦性决定几何交换何时成为内禀拓扑。

title: Hydrogen-Bond Density Drives the Order-Disorder Phase Transition from Orientational to Vibrational in Polyalcohol Plastic Crystals
summary: Neopentane-derived plastic crystals undergo order-disorder phase transitions accompanied by exceptionally large entropy changes, making them attractive solid-state materials for thermal energy storage and barocaloric cooling. Yet it remains unclear whether the microscopic nature of this entropy change is an intrinsic property of each compound or can be understood generally and tuned systematically through molecular design. Here, we use classical molecular dynamics simulations of neopentyl glycol (NPG), pentaglycerine (PG), and pentaerythritol (PE), validated against experimental transition temperatures, enthalpy changes, and phase diagrams, to show that the character of the phase-transition entropy undergoes a complete inversion as the hydrogen-bond connectivity of the molecule increases: orientational disordering dominates in NPG, whereas lattice vibrations dominate in PE and become remarkably robust against pressure. PG occupies a balanced intermediate regime in which the orientational, conformational, and vibrational channels contribute comparably. This inversion reflects two coupled microscopic mechanisms: a growing low-frequency gap between the phonon densities of states of the ordered and disordered phases as the hydrogen-bond network densifies, and an increase in molecular symmetry that progressively suppresses orientational disordering. Because the vibrational channel is substantially less sensitive to pressure than the orientational one, hydrogen-bond density emerges as a practical, chemically accessible design handle for tailoring not only the magnitude but also the pressure robustness of the caloric response in hydrogen-bonded plastic crystals, with direct implications for the search for new barocaloric and thermal-energy-storage materials.

AI.tldr: 通过NPG、PG、PE的分子动力学模拟，发现随氢键连通性增强，相变熵的来源从取向无序主导完全反转为振动主导，氢键密度可作为调控热响应及其压力稳健性的设计抓手。
AI.motivation: 新戊烷类塑晶具有极大熵变的有序-无序相变，是储能与压卡制冷的候选材料，但熵变的微观来源是各化合物固有属性还是可普遍理解、可分子设计调控，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对NPG、PG、PE进行经典分子动力学模拟，并用实验相变温度、焓变与相图进行验证；分解取向、构象、振动三类熵通道，并分析声子态密度与分子对称性的作用。
AI.result: 相变熵性质随氢键连通性增加发生完全反转：NPG由取向无序主导，PE由晶格振动主导且对压力异常稳健，PG处于三者相当的中间区。机制为低频声子态密度间隙增大与分子对称性提高抑制取向无序两方面耦合。
AI.conclusion: 振动通道对压力远不如取向通道敏感，因此氢键密度是可化学调控的手段，可同时调节热卡效应的幅度与压力稳健性，为新型压卡与储热材料设计提供指导。

title: Altermagnetic Ground States on the Ammann--Beenker Tiling
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures + Supplemental Material (14 pages, 6 figures)
summary: We identify exact altermagnetic ground states of a classical Heisenberg model on a quasicrystal. Considering the Ammann--Beenker tiling as an example, we determine the ground states by exploiting the parity structure of its parent four-dimensional hypercubic lattice. The ground state hosts coplanar altermagnetic order characterized by the preserved spin-group symmetry $[C_{2x}\parallel C_{8z}]$. Without translational symmetry, the momentum-space spin splitting that usually identifies altermagnets is not directly accessible. We instead couple the spins to itinerant electrons and show spin-resolved transport with $g$-wave symmetry, confirming the altermagnetic nature in a nonperiodic system. Our results establish a geometric route to altermagnetic order in quasicrystals, connecting exact magnetic ground states to their spin-resolved transport signatures.

AI.tldr: 本文在Ammann--Beenker准晶上的经典海森堡模型中给出精确的交变磁(alternagnetic)基态，并通过自旋分辨输运证实其g波自旋劈裂。
AI.motivation: 交变磁通常依赖平移对称性来定义动量空间自旋劈裂，而在准晶这类非周期体系中如何定义与识别交变磁序尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以Ammann--Beenker拼图为范例，利用其母体四维超立方晶格的宇称结构求解精确基态；再让局域自旋与巡游电子耦合，计算自旋分辨输运。
AI.result: 基态为共面交变磁序，保留自旋群对称性 [C2x ∥ C8z]；尽管无平移对称性导致动量空间劈裂不可直接定义，耦合电子后呈现具有g波对称性的自旋分辨输运。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一条在准晶中实现交变磁序的几何路径，将精确磁基态与其自旋分辨输运特征联系起来，把交变磁概念拓展到非周期体系。

title: Learning from fracture: Teaching language models to design through physical experience
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Includes Supplementary Materials
summary: How can language models learn to optimize physical designs through experience? We introduce FracLearn, an experience-abstraction-generalization framework evaluated through a deliberately unfamiliar, Tetris-inspired fracture game. The model first proposes architectures and examines simulated fracture responses to accumulate experience. Abstraction organizes these observations into conditional principles linking reinforcement placement, crack evolution and load transfer, with supporting evidence and failure conditions. Generalization challenges the model to combine these principles in new architectures and surpass the earlier design record. Campaigns demonstrate progressive refinement and recovery through hypothesis revision, yielding a best composite score 11.0% above the experience-stage record. Fracture analyses connect improved performance to crack deflection and temporary trapping as toughening mechanisms, alongside greater residual load capacity. Learning occurs through external knowledge and decisions, without model-weight updates. This approach offers a route to scientific agents that turn computational experiments into reusable physical knowledge for materials discovery and engineering design.

AI.tldr: FracLearn 是一个"经验—抽象—泛化"框架，让语言模型在类俄罗斯方块断裂游戏中通过模拟实验积累经验、抽象为原理，并迁移到新架构上超越先前纪录。
AI.motivation: 探索语言模型能否像人一样通过经验学习物理设计优化，而非依赖模型权重更新；需要一个刻意陌生、可控的任务来检验其科学推理与迁移能力。
AI.method: 模型先提出架构并观察模拟的断裂响应以积累经验；随后将观察抽象为连接"钢筋布置—裂纹演化—载荷传递"的条件性原理，附带证据与失效条件；再在泛化阶段于新架构中组合这些原理以超越先前设计纪录，整个过程仅通过外部知识与决策完成学习，不更新模型参数。
AI.result: 多轮实验展现了渐进式改进及通过假设修正实现的能力恢复，最佳复合得分比经验阶段纪录高 11.0%；断裂分析表明性能提升源于裂纹偏折与暂时捕获等增韧机制，以及更高的残余承载能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明不更新权重亦可让模型把计算实验转化为可复用的物理知识，为面向材料发现与工程设计的科学智能体提供路径。

title: Unexpected stabilization of a single-$q$ charge density wave in pristine 1T-TiSe$_2$
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in Nature Communications. Supplementary Information is not included in this arXiv version and is available with the published article at https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-78072-0
summary: Over the past decade, studies revisiting the classical charge-density-wave system 1T-TiSe$_2$, long understood to host the $2 \times 2$ triple-$q$ order with equivalent subcomponents, have suggested that these subcomponents may not be identical, challenging a 50-year-old paradigm. Here, we demonstrate not only that these subcomponents are non-identical but also that they develop sequentially rather than simultaneously. By tracking folded-band features, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals that a unidirectional $2 \times 1$ single-$q$ order stabilizes first, while the other two components emerge sequentially at lower temperatures, completing the triple-$q$ phase. Our free-energy analysis explains this hierarchy through repulsive coupling among the three subcomponents, as supported by first-principles calculations incorporating phonon anharmonicity. Consequently, the three subcomponents are inequivalent in both phase and amplitude. These results reconcile reported symmetry breaking and differing characteristic temperatures and establish a framework in which ostensibly simple, high-symmetry charge-density order emerges from temperature-dependent competition and cooperation among inequivalent subcomponents.

AI.tldr: 1T-TiSe₂的2×2三-q电荷密度波并非三个等价分量同时形成，而是先建立单向2×1单-q序，另两个分量在更低温度依次出现，最终构成不等价的三-q相。
AI.motivation: 经典理论认为1T-TiSe₂的2×2三-q序由三个等价子分量构成，但近十年重访研究提示这些子分量可能并不相同，动摇了延续50年的范式；本文要验证其是否不等价，以及它们是否同时形成。
AI.method: 利用角分辨光电子能谱追踪折叠能带特征，分辨各子分量出现的温度顺序；并通过自由能分析结合含声子非谐性的第一性原理计算，解释该层级出现的物理机制。
AI.result: 实验观测到单向2×1单-q序最先稳定，另两个分量在更低温度依次出现并最终完成三-q相；自由能分析表明三个子分量之间的排斥耦合导致这种层级，第一性原理计算（含声子非谐性）予以支持；三个子分量在相位与振幅上均不等价。
AI.conclusion: 该工作调和了此前报道的对称性破缺与不同特征温度的差异，建立了“表观高对称的电荷密度序由不等价子分量随温度竞争与协作而生成”的框架。

title: Polarons in Lead-Halide Perovskites: What the Structural Evidence Does and Does Not Establish
summary: Photogenerated carriers in lead-halide perovskites are widely believed to move as large polarons, whose accompanying lattice distortion is thought to screen the carrier from charged defects. Three recent findings call this picture into question. First, time-resolved structural probes now measure the photoinduced lattice distortion directly; yet calculations show that thermal motion of the lattice alone can raise the carrier effective mass-an increase previously taken as evidence for polarons-so that it remains unclear whether the lattice distortion around a carrier is really a polaron. Second, the carrier-lattice coupling strengthens as the material is thinned from 3D to 2D. In the two main families of 2D perovskites, Ruddlesden-Popper and Dion-Jacobson, the carrier couples to the lattice through different channels, and their contrasting behavior is set by which coupling channel dominates rather than by lattice stiffness alone. Third, the first direct test of defect tolerance does not point to polaron screening; its authors attribute defect tolerance to the soft, disordered lattice. New transport data show that polaron screening reduces scattering between carriers, but not that it protects carriers from defects. Polaron formation, even if established, therefore does not establish polarons as the cause of defect tolerance. Separating the two requires measuring the lattice distortion as a function of excitation density, over a range spanning the low densities of a solar cell under sunlight and the much higher densities used in most ultrafast experiments. On this basis, we propose experiments that can clarify how photogenerated carriers behave in lead-halide perovskites.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"卤化铅钙钛矿中光生载流子以大极化子形式运动并屏蔽缺陷"的主流图像，基于三项新证据指出极化子形成不等于缺陷容忍，并提出以激发密度依赖的晶格畸变测量来区分二者的实验方案。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为钙钛矿光生载流子以大极化子形式存在，其伴随的晶格畸变可屏蔽载流子与带电缺陷的相互作用，从而解释缺陷容忍性。但三项近期结果对该图像提出挑战：时间分辨结构探测与热运动效应使晶格畸变是否真为极化子存疑；2D钙钛矿中载流子-晶格耦合通道不同；首个缺陷容忍直接测试未指向极化子屏蔽。
AI.method: 综述与批判性分析：梳理时间分辨结构探测与计算结果（热运动本身可提高有效质量）；比较Ruddlesden-Popper与Dion-Jacobson两类2D钙钛矿中不同耦合通道的主导作用；重新审视缺陷容忍的直接测试与输运数据（极化子屏蔽降低载流子间散射，而非保护载流子免受缺陷影响）。据此提出实验设计：在跨越太阳光照低密度至超快实验高密度的激发密度范围内，测量晶格畸变随激发密度的变化。
AI.result: 有效质量增大不足以作为极化子证据（热运动亦可导致）；2D钙钛矿行为差异由主导耦合通道而非晶格刚度决定；缺陷容忍更可能源于柔软无序晶格而非极化子屏蔽；输运数据仅显示极化子屏蔽减少载流子间散射，未显示对缺陷的保护。
AI.conclusion: 极化子的存在（即便被证实）并不等于极化子是缺陷容忍的成因，二者需分开验证。关键在于测量晶格畸变随激发密度的依赖关系，覆盖太阳能电池工作低密度与超快实验高密度区间；据此提出可澄清卤化铅钙钛矿光生载流子行为的实验方案。

title: Quantitative Modelling of Solvation in 2D Materials via Alchemical Decoupling and Potential Energy Surfaces
summary: Understanding why 2D materials remain suspended in solutions is essential to understanding the mechanisms of aggregation and exfoliation. These dynamics have been difficult to model because of the long timescales and large activation energies involved in these simulations. Here we describe an improved strategy for modelling the solvation and stability of 2D materials that uses the Gibbs free energy of solvation to accurately calibrate two disconnected potential energy surfaces for the fully desolvated and fully solvated 2D materials. By joining these surfaces using solvation energy, we obtain predictions for 2D material stability in various solvents that are qualitatively different than prior simulations and that have excellent agreement with experimental results. Our approach predicts a much higher barrier to full desolvation of the material, suggesting that materials that appear to be aggregated in fact still retain monolayers of solvent between adjacent layers of 2D materials. This work provides much needed understanding on the interactions between the solvent and 2D material that can guide future experimental work.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用溶剂化吉布斯自由能校准"完全脱溶剂"与"完全溶剂化"两个不连通势能面的建模策略，可更准确预测2D材料在溶剂中的稳定性与聚集/剥离行为。
AI.motivation: 理解2D材料为何能在溶液中保持悬浮，对揭示聚集与剥离机制至关重要；但相关过程涉及长时标与高活化能，难以直接模拟，且以往模拟对稳定性的预测与实验不符。
AI.method: 利用溶剂化吉布斯自由能校准两个原本不连通的势能面（完全脱溶剂态与完全溶剂化态），再通过溶剂化能将其连接，从而计算2D材料在不同溶剂中的稳定性。
AI.result: 预测结果与以往模拟在定性上不同，却与实验结果高度吻合；模型预测完全脱溶剂存在高得多的能垒。
AI.conclusion: 看似已聚集的2D材料实际在相邻层间仍保留单层溶剂；该工作加深了对溶剂—2D材料相互作用的理解，可指导后续实验。

title: Orthoexciton-to-paraexciton conversion rate in Cu$_2$O at sub-Kelvin temperatures
summary: We measured the conversion rate from 1s orthoexcitons to 1s paraexcitons in Cu$_2$O below 1 K using a dilution refrigerator. To determine the conversion rate, we performed time-resolved luminescence spectroscopy of 1s orthoexcitons and 1s paraexcitons confined in a strain-induced trap potential. From the time evolution of the $Γ$$_3$$^{-}$-LO-phonon-assisted luminescence of 1s orthoexcitons, we obtained a conversion rate of $5.9 \times 10^7$ s${^{-1}}$ at a mixing-chamber temperature of 64 mK under an applied stress of 2.2 kbar. Between 64 and 800 mK, the conversion rate depends only weakly on temperature, and it is less than half of the value of $1.6 \times 10^8$ s${^{-1}}$ reported at 2 K under the same applied stress. The conversion rate therefore continues to decrease below 2 K, contrary to the previous expectation that it becomes nearly constant below about 1.7 K. We discuss these results in terms of the momentum distribution of orthoexcitons, which does not reach equilibrium with the lattice during the conversion at these low temperatures. These findings call for a theory that accounts for both the small magnitude of the conversion rate and its weak temperature dependence below 1 K.

AI.tldr: 在1 K以下测量Cu2O中1s正激子到1s仲激子的转换速率，发现其随温度降低持续减小且温度依赖很弱，与先前"低于1.7 K趋于恒定"的预期相悖。
AI.motivation: 以往认为正激子到仲激子的转换速率在约1.7 K以下趋于常数，但低温下缺乏实验验证，需要测定1 K以下的行为以检验该预期并理解转换机制。
AI.method: 用稀释制冷机在64 mK–800 mK、应力2.2 kbar下，对受限在应变诱导陷阱中的1s正激子与1s仲激子进行时间分辨发光光谱，通过Γ3⁻-LO声子辅助发光的时序演化提取转换速率。
AI.result: 64 mK时转换速率为5.9×10^7 s^-1，仅为相同应力下2 K处报道值（1.6×10^8 s^-1）的一半以下；64–800 mK间速率对温度依赖很弱，说明其随降温持续下降而非趋于平台。
AI.conclusion: 低温下转换过程中正激子动量分布未与晶格达到平衡，可解释速率偏小及其弱温度依赖；现有理论不足，需要能同时描述转换速率幅度与1 K以下弱温度依赖的新理论。

title: Superexchange coupling between a dilute Gd3+ probe and orphan spins in a valence-bond glass
summary: The valence-bond-glass state of the 4d^1 double perovskite Ba2YMoO6 combines Mo^5+ singlets with residual paramagnetic "orphan" spins whose coupling is hard to reach with bulk probes. We probe them by electron paramagnetic resonance of a dilute Gd^3+ ion on the Y^3+ site via broadband coplanar-waveguide transmission at 5 K. The isostructural nonmagnetic niobate Ba2YNbO6, doped with the same Gd^3+ probe, is a fixed-lattice control. The Gd^3+ linewidth nearly doubles in the magnetic host. Dipolar coupling to the sparse orphans is nearly an order of magnitude too weak; the excess is instead reproduced by a transferred f-d superexchange of J ~ 0.2 K, so the width is a static measure of orphan-spin coupling. The half-field (Delta m_S = +/-2) satellite collapses in the magnetic host, a dynamical dephasing channel, while the unchanged g-factor marks a zero-mean random internal field. Together the two channels probe the coupling and dynamics of valence-bond-glass orphan spins.

AI.tldr: 通过稀释Gd^3+探针的EPR测量，揭示Ba2YMoO6价键玻璃态中"孤儿"自旋的耦合强度(J~0.2 K)与动力学退相干通道。
AI.motivation: Ba2YMoO6的价键玻璃态由Mo^5+单态与残余顺磁"孤儿"自旋构成，但其耦合过弱、难以被体探针探测，需寻找新手段。
AI.method: 在Y位掺入极稀Gd^3+探针，于5 K用宽带共面波导透射进行EPR测量；并以同构非磁性Ba2YNbO6作固定晶格对照。
AI.result: 磁性宿主中Gd^3+线宽近乎加倍，偶极耦合弱近一个量级，可由J~0.2 K的转移f-d超交换解释；半场(Δm_S=±2)卫星线塌缩显示动力学退相干，而g因子不变表明内部场为零均值随机场。
AI.conclusion: 线宽与半场卫星两个通道分别静态度量孤儿自旋的耦合、动态反映其退相干，共同表征价键玻璃态孤儿自旋。

title: ARES: a plane-wave density-functional-theory code in Rust
summary: ARES (Ab initio atomic mateRial modEling Software at JLU) is a plane-wave density-functional-theory (DFT) code written entirely in Rust as a layered 22-crate workspace. It supports norm-conserving pseudopotentials and the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method with the local-density approximation (LDA) and Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functionals, Γ-only and explicit k-point sampling, smearing and mixing, forces, stress, relaxation, band structures, densities of states (DOS) and dispersion corrections; execution is serial or MPI-distributed over k-point pools, band groups and plane-wave rows. The code's distinguishing engineering choice is its validation apparatus. Every numerical component is checked against Quantum ESPRESSO driven from the same physical and numerical inputs, and the comparison is organized as numbered fixtures kept in the repository whose reference data is regenerated by a script instead of being captured once. On six materials spanning a semiconductor, three metals and two two-dimensional systems, band energies within one electronvolt of the Fermi level agree with the reference to a median below 0.4 meV. The pseudopotentials the code reads are validated against all-electron reference data as well: the median delta factor is 0.696 meV/atom over all 65 paired elements. Restrictions are stated with the capabilities: two functionals, no spin-polarized or spin-orbit path, a stress implementation with an explicit scope, and no accelerator execution.

AI.tldr: ARES is a Rust-based plane-wave DFT code (22-crate workspace) supporting NC/PAW pseudopotentials, LDA/PBE, k-point sampling, forces/stress/relaxation/bands/DOS, serial or MPI; its key engineering feature is a fixture-based validation harness that continuously re-derives Quantum ESPRESSO reference data, with band-energy median error <0.4 meV and pseudopotential delta factor 0.696 meV/atom over 65 elements.
AI.motivation: Existing plane-wave DFT codes are typically mature but large legacy C/Fortran codebases whose numerical correctness is hard to audit; the authors want a modern, memory-safe (Rust) implementation whose every numerical component is systematically and reporducibly validated against an established reference code rather than relying on one-off, manually captured comparisons.
AI.method: A layered 22-crate Rust workspace implementing plane-wave DFT with norm-conserving and PAW pseudopotentials, LDA/PBE, Γ-only and explicit k-points, smearing and mixing, forces, stress, relaxation, band structures, DOS and dispersion corrections, parallelized serially or via MPI over k-point pools, band groups and plane-wave rows. Validation is organized as numbered repository fixtures whose QE reference data is regenerated by script from identical physical/numerical inputs; pseudopotentials are additionally checked against all-electron data via the delta factor.
AI.result: On six materials (one semiconductor, three metals, two 2D systems), band energies within 1 eV of the Fermi level match QE with a median deviation below 0.4 meV; across all 65 paired elements the median pseudopotential delta factor is 0.696 meV/atom.
AI.conclusion: ARES demonstrates that a from-scratch Rust plane-wave DFT code can reproduce a mature reference code to sub-meV accuracy, and that script-regenerated fixture-based validation is a practical, transparent engineering pattern. Limitations are explicitly stated: only two functionals, no spin-polarized or spin-orbit support, a stress implementation with restricted scope, and no GPU/accelerator execution.

title: Thermal stability and structural ordering of thick Co$_2$MnAl films grown on MgO and Si substrates
summary: While most studies on Co$2$MnAl (CMA) focus on the ultrathin regime for spintronic junctions, applications scaling with magnetic volume--such as Anomalous Nernst Effect (ANE) energy harvesters, integrated power inductors, and magnetic MEMS--require significantly thicker films. In this work, 750 nm thick CMA films were grown on MgO (001) and Si substrates to establish a roadmap for their thermal integration. Structural analysis reveals that B2 ordering is optimized on MgO at 600 $^\circ$C, which is important for functional devices. In contrast, samples on Si substrates exhibit a disorder transition toward the A2 phase, closely linked to diffusion-driven degradation processes. Above 500 $^\circ$C, Si interdiffusion into the Heusler layer triggers the formation of interfacial silicides and Kirkendall voids, leading to microcracking, electrical resistivity jumps, and a final fully disordered A2 phase. Despite the Mn-poor stoichiometry (Co$2.25$Mn$0.7$Al$1.05$), the films maintain a robust saturation magnetization of ~600 emu/cm$^3$, consistent with recent theoretical models for off-stoichiometric Heusler alloys. These results define the processing windows for integrating thick CMA layers into multifunctional CMOS-compatible platforms.

AI.tldr: 该文研究750 nm厚Co2MnAl薄膜在MgO(001)和Si衬底上的热集成路线：MgO上600°C实现B2有序，Si上超过500°C发生互扩散导致A2无序与失效。
AI.motivation: 现有CMA研究多集中于超薄自旋电子结，但ANE能量收集器、集成电感、磁MEMS等需要大磁性体积的厚膜，亟需明确其热集成工艺窗口。
AI.method: 在MgO(001)与Si衬底上生长750 nm厚CMA薄膜，进行结构分析（有序度、相变）与电/磁表征，考察退火温度演化和Si互扩散行为。
AI.result: MgO上600°C获得最优B2有序；Si上出现向A2的失序转变，>500°C时Si互扩散形成界面硅化物与Kirkendall空洞，引起微裂纹、电阻率突增及完全A2相。Mn贫化学计量(Co2.25Mn0.7Al1.05)下仍保持~600 emu/cm^3的饱和磁化强度，与近期非化学计量Heusler理论一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究界定了厚CMA层集成到CMOS兼容多功能平台的工艺温度窗口，强调衬底选择与界面扩散对厚膜功能性的关键影响。

title: A hierarchy of exact lower bounds on the Laughlin spectral gap
summary: We develop a bootstrap approach to deriving lower bounds on the spectral gap of the first Haldane pseudopotential Hamiltonian on the sphere with $N_Φ$ flux quanta for arbitrary $N_Φ$, including in the thermodynamic limit $N_Φ\to \infty$. Our approach can in principle be generalized to pseudopotentials describing other model wavefunctions such as the Moore-Read state or Read-Rezayi sequence. Our approach is based on Knabe's observation that if $H$ is a Hamiltonian with ground state energy $0$ then the spectral gap is at least $ε> 0$ if and only if $H^2 \succeq εH$. To show this inequality, we split $H^2$ into two parts, one that can be analytically bounded and another that can be bounded using a finite semidefinite program (SDP). Crucially, the size of this program is determined only by cutoff parameters, and the program depends on $N_Φ$ only parametrically, allowing us to obtain numerically exact (up to solver precision) lower bounds on the gap. In order to turn these numerical bounds into mathematically rigorous bounds, we introduce an algorithm that can produce nearly-optimal exact feasible points for large rational SDPs. We additionally provide an algorithm that establishes the rank stability of the semidefinite program in the limit $N_Φ\to \infty$ which is needed to certify the bound in the thermodynamic limit. Beyond establishing the Laughlin gap and revealing a potential method for deriving spectral gap lower bounds for other pseudopotentials, our work provides a general method for turning numerical semidefinite programming bounds into rigorous mathematical proofs, which may have wide applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于"bootstrap"+半定规划(SDP)的方法,给出球面上第一 Haldane 赝势哈密顿量谱隙的严格下界,对任意磁通数 N_Φ 乃至热力学极限均成立。
AI.motivation: 分数量子霍尔体系中 Laughlin 态的能隙在热力学极限下是否有下界缺乏严格证明;现有数值结果不具数学严格性,需要可推广到任意 N_Φ 与热力学极限的严格谱隙下界方法。
AI.method: 利用 Knabe 观察:基态能量为 0 时谱隙 ≥ ε 当且仅当 H² ⪰ εH。将 H² 拆为可解析界的部分与用有限 SDP 界定的部分;SDP 规模仅由截断参数决定、对 N_Φ 仅参数化依赖。并提出算法为大有理数 SDP 构造近似最优的精确可行点(数值界→严格证明),以及证明 N_Φ→∞ 时 SDP 秩稳定性的算法。
AI.result: 得到第一 Haldane 赝势谱隙在任意 N_Φ 及热力学极限下的数值精确(至求解器精度)且可严格化的下界;确立了 Laughlin 能隙。
AI.conclusion: 方法原则上可推广到 Moore-Read、Read-Rezayi 等赝势;更一般地,提供了将数值 SDP 界转化为严格数学证明的通用范式,具有广泛适用性。

title: Field-free Magnetoacoustic Nonreciprocity via Exchange-bias Engineering
summary: Nonreciprocal wave propagation is essential for directional signal processing and isolation. Magnetoacoustic systems are attractive platforms for nonreciprocal devices because of their small footprint and passive operation. However, pronounced nonreciprocity typically requires an external bias field,limiting device miniaturization and integration. Here, we demonstrate field-free magnetoacoustic nonreciprocity in an IrMn/FeGaB/Cu/FeGaB multilayer integrated with a shear-horizontal-wave delay line. Exchange-bias engineering stabilizes a remanent magnetic state with broken time-reversal and spatial-inversion symmetries while tailoring the spin-wave dispersion to achieve resonant magnetoacoustic coupling at zero field. The normalized isolation reaches 21 dB/mm, with its sign programmable by the field-sweep history. Further numerical optimization predicts a zero-field normalized isolation of 91 dB/mm by increasing the dynamical magnetic asymmetry. Our work establishes exchange-bias engineering as a promising route toward compact RF isolators and circulators and as a general strategy for realizing magnetoacoustic devices without external magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 该工作展示了基于交换偏置工程的零外场磁声非互易传播。
AI.motivation: 磁声系统可实现小型化、无源非互易器件，但通常需要外加偏置磁场，限制了器件小型化和集成。
AI.method: 在IrMn/FeGaB/Cu/FeGaB多层膜与剪切水平波延迟线集成的结构中，利用交换偏置稳定剩余磁态，打破时间反演与空间反演对称性，并调控自旋波色散以在零场下实现共振磁声耦合。
AI.result: 归一化隔离度达到21 dB/mm，且符号可由磁场扫描历史编程；进一步数值优化预测，通过增大动态磁不对称性可实现91 dB/mm的零场归一化隔离度。
AI.conclusion: 交换偏置工程是通往紧凑型射频隔离器与环行器的一条有前景路径，也是实现无外场磁声器件的通用策略。

title: Knowledge-Guided Construction of Machine Learning Potentials for Reactive Behavior in Energetic Materials
summary: Energetic materials involve multiple interactions, making reliable machine-learning potentials (MLPs) difficult to construct without extensive datasets. Here, we enhance the ability of the neural network interatomic potential (NNAP) to describe molecular systems using sphmulti, a refined spherical-harmonic basis set that combines extra radial basis with element-specific chemical weighting in each radial channel. We further integrate hyperactive learning, farthest-point sampling, and iterative sufficiency criteria with knowledge-guided key events, enabling the NNAP to retain essential information for describing the material system. For 3,3'-diamino-4,4'-azoxyfurazan, the resulting NNAP is trained on only 13,680 configurations yet captures key properties, including the isomerization barrier, pyrolysis activation energy, and shock Hugoniot behavior. NNAP-driven molecular dynamics simulations further reveal that pyrolysis proceeds through furazan-ring opening followed by chain reactions, whereas shock loading induces anisotropic hydrogen transfer driven by interlayer structural deformations. This work enables efficient and reliable MLPs for energetic materials.

AI.tldr: 提出改进球形谐波基组sphmulti与主动学习策略，仅用13,680构型即构建可靠的神经网络势，成功描述含能材料DAAzF的关键性质与动力学机制。
AI.motivation: 含能材料涉及多重复杂相互作用，构建可靠机器学习势通常需要大规模数据集，成本高昂；作者希望提升NNAP对分子体系的描述能力，并在小数据集下保持关键物理信息。
AI.method: 提出sphmulti球形谐波基组：在每个径向通道中结合额外径向基函数与元素特定化学权重；并将hyperactive learning、最远点采样、带知识引导关键事件的迭代充分性判据整合为训练流程。
AI.result: 对3,3'-二氨基-4,4'-偶氮呋咱（DAAzF），仅用13,680个构型训练即准确复现异构化能垒、热解活化能与冲击Hugoniot行为；MD模拟揭示热解经历呋咱环开环后链式反应，冲击加载则因层间结构变形引发各向异性氢转移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为含能材料提供了高效可靠的机器学习势构建方案，兼具数据效率与物理可解释性。

title: Twofold Symmetry Observed in Bi$_{2}$Te$_{3}$/FeTe Interfacial Superconductor
summary: Superconducting pairing symmetry are crucial in understanding the microscopic superconducting mechanism of a superconductor. Here we report the observation of a twofold superconducting gap symmetry in an interfacial superconductor Bi$_{2}$Te$_{3}$/FeTe, by employing quasiparticle interference (QPI) technique in scanning tunneling microscopy and macroscopic magnetoresistance measurements. The QPI patterns corresponding to energies inside and outside the gap reveal a clear anisotropic superconducting gap. Furthermore, both the in-plane angle-dependent magnetoresistance and in-plane upper critical field exhibit a clear twofold symmetry. This twofold symmetry align with the Te-Te direction in FeTe, which weakens the possible generation by bi-collinear antiferromagnetism order. Our finding provides key information in further understanding of the topological properties in Bi$_{2}$Te$_{3}$/FeTe superconducting system and propels further theoretical interests in the paring mechanism in the system.

AI.tldr: 该文通过扫描隧道显微镜准粒子干涉(QPI)与宏观磁阻测量，在界面超导体Bi2Te3/FeTe中观测到二重超导能隙对称性，并与FeTe的Te-Te方向对齐。
AI.motivation: 超导配对对称性是理解超导微观机制的关键，而Bi2Te3/FeTe体系的配对对称性尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用STM/QPI技术测量能隙内外能量的干涉图样以判断能隙各向异性；同时进行面内角度依赖的磁阻和面内上临界场测量。
AI.result: 能隙内外的QPI图样显示明显的各向异性超导能隙；面内角度依赖磁阻与面内上临界场均呈现清晰的二重对称性，且对称方向与FeTe的Te-Te方向一致。
AI.conclusion: 该二重对称性与双共线反铁磁序的可能贡献不符，为理解Bi2Te3/FeTe的拓扑性质及配对机制提供了关键信息。

title: Hydrogen partial pressure as a key parameter in the reactive sputtering of photochromic YHO thin films
summary: Oxygen-containing yttrium hydride (YHO) thin films were synthesised by reactive magnetron sputtering over a wide range of hydrogen-to-argon gas flow ratios (H2/Ar) during yttrium hydride deposition, followed by post-oxidation in air. The deposition process was monitored in situ by plasma optical emission spectroscopy. X-ray diffraction reveals a strong dependence of crystallographic texture on the H2/Ar ratio: highly <100>-textured films formed at low H2/Ar ratios progressively evolve into more polycrystalline microstructures with slightly reduced crystallite size as the hydrogen content increases. The optical transmittance gradually decreases from approximately 85 % to 70 % as the H2/Ar ratio is raised to 0.6, followed by a sharp drop at higher hydrogen contents. The photochromic contrast of 705-845 nm thick YHO films, measured after 10 min of illumination with a solar simulator, decreases from 14 % to 7 % as the H2/Ar ratio increases from 0.08 to 0.45. Thinner films (365-505 nm) exhibit a similar but less pronounced trend. Bleaching kinetics, analysed using a double-exponential model, indicate faster recovery, with effective bleaching time constants of approximately 1-15 min for films deposited at H2/Ar < 0.25. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals higher oxygen incorporation in films deposited at lower H2/Ar ratios, deviating from the commonly reported correlation between oxygen content and photochromic response in YHO. These results demonstrate that low hydrogen partial pressure during reactive sputtering is advantageous for achieving higher optical transparency, enhanced photochromic contrast, and faster bleaching kinetics in YHO thin films.

AI.tldr: 通过调控反应磁控溅射中H2/Ar流量比并辅以空气后氧化制备YHO薄膜，发现低H2/Ar比有利于高透明性、高光致变色对比度和快速漂白动力学。
AI.motivation: 研究氢含量（以H2/Ar气体流量比表征）对含氧氢化钇（YHO）薄膜结构、光学透明性、光致变色对比度及漂白动力学的影响，并厘清氧含量与光致变色响应的关系。
AI.method: 反应磁控溅射沉积氢化钇（H2/Ar比范围宽），空气后氧化；等离子体发射光谱原位监测；XRD分析织构与晶粒；透射光谱、太阳模拟器光照10 min测光致变色对比度；双指数模型拟合漂白动力学；XPS测氧含量。
AI.result: 低H2/Ar时形成强<100>织构，氢增加后趋于多晶且晶粒略减小；透射率由约85%降至70%（H2/Ar=0.6），更高氢含量时急剧下降；705–845 nm厚膜光致变色对比度由14%降至7%（H2/Ar 0.08→0.45），薄膜（365–505 nm）趋势相似但较弱；H2/Ar<0.25的样品漂白时间常数约1–15 min；低H2/Ar样品氧含量更高，与常报道的氧含量—光致变色正相关不符。
AI.conclusion: 反应溅射时低氢分压有利于获得更高透明度、更强光致变色对比度和更快漂白，为YHO薄膜性能优化提供工艺依据。

title: Tellurium trioxide as an n-type wide-gap semiconductor with ultrahigh work functions from first principles
summary: The exploration of next-generation wide-gap semiconductors with extreme work functions is highly desirable for the continued advancement of electronic and optoelectronic devices. By using first principles calculations, we show that \b{eta}-TeO3, with a wide band gap exceeding 3 eV, emerges as a promising n-type semiconductor exhibiting ultrahigh work functions of up to ~8 eV. Intentionally or unintentionally incorporated interstitial H, Li, Na, Cu, Mg, and Zn impurities and substitutional F impurities are identified as shallow donors, whereas O vacancies act as minor carrier-compensating defects that locally trap electrons at neighbouring Te sites. The work function is evaluated across a series of low-index nonpolar surfaces. The presence of ordered O vacancies is energetically favoured on these surfaces and tends to reduce the corresponding work functions. These findings underscore the significance of precise control over the O chemical potential to suppress surface O-vacancy formation, thereby preserving the exceptional electronic performance of \b{eta}-TeO3 associated with ultrahigh work functions. Collectively, the results highlight the potential of \b{eta}-TeO3 for hole injection/extraction/transport layers as well as transparent electrodes for applications such as light-emitting devices and photovoltaic cells, while providing useful guidance on carrier doping and surface tuning for these practical applications through elucidating the effects of the point-defect and surface configurations on the electronic properties.

AI.tldr: 第一性原理计算表明，β-TeO3（带隙>3 eV）可成为功函数高达~8 eV的n型半导体，适合空穴注入/传输层与透明电极，但需精准控制O化学势以抑制表面氧空位。
AI.motivation: 面向电子与光电器件的持续发展，亟需探索具有极端功函数的下一代宽禁带半导体材料。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，系统研究β-TeO3的能带结构、点缺陷（间隙H、Li、Na、Cu、Mg、Zn及替代F；O空位）与低指数非极性表面的功函数，并考察有序氧空位对表面的影响。
AI.result: β-TeO3带隙超过3 eV，功函数最高约8 eV；间隙H、Li、Na、Cu、Mg、Zn及替代F为浅施主，O空位为次要的载流子补偿缺陷，在邻近Te位点局域俘获电子；有序O空位在表面能量上更有利，并降低功函数。
AI.conclusion: β-TeO3在高功函数空穴注入/提取/传输层及透明电极方面具应用潜力；实际应用需通过控制O化学势抑制表面氧空位，并据此指导载流子掺杂与表面调控。

title: High-throughput screening of Heusler alloys for thermoelectrics combining machine-learned densities of states and first-principles transport
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables; Supplementary Information (21 pages) included
summary: Thermoelectrics turn waste heat into electricity, but finding new ones requires transport calculations too costly for whole databases. Searches therefore choose what to calculate from the electronic density of states (DOS), increasingly predicted by machine learning, yet such choices are rarely tested. We test them on all 106,235 Heusler structures in the DXMag database, screening 51,257 on density-functional spectra and 54,978 on neural-network predictions, and judging both by 3,625 band-structure and transport calculations. A DOS-derived Seebeck indicator ranks most compounds passing every transport and stability test within the top 1% of their population, and ten of the eleven established half-Heusler thermoelectrics calculated pass. Predicted spectra lose most band gaps, unnoticed by spectral-similarity metrics, yet still rank passing compounds near the top. The screen certifies 80 computational candidates, 61 without reported measurements. Computed or predicted, the DOS can choose what to calculate; only a band structure shows whether a gap exists.

AI.tldr: 该文检验了以态密度(DOS)为依据的热电材料筛选策略是否可靠：在DXMag数据库全部106,235个Heusler结构中，用DFT谱筛选51,257个、用神经网络预测谱筛选54,978个，并以3,625次能带与输运计算作为判据。结果显示DOS衍生的Seebeck指标能把大多数通过全部输运与稳定性测试的化合物排进其族群前1%，但预测谱会丢失大部分带隙。
AI.motivation: 热电材料可将废热转为电能，但全数据库范围内的输运计算代价过高，因此通常依据电子态密度(DOS)决定哪些材料值得计算；机器学习预测DOS也日益普遍，然而这种"以DOS挑选候选"的做法很少被系统检验。
AI.method: 在DXMag数据库全部106,235个Heusler结构上进行筛选检验：51,257个依据DFT谱筛选，54,978个依据神经网络预测谱筛选，并用3,625个能带结构与输运计算对两类筛选结果统一评估；同时比较由DOS导出的Seebeck指标与谱相似度指标的表现。
AI.result: DOS衍生的Seebeck指标将大多数通过全部输运与稳定性测试的化合物排在其族群前1%以内；11个已知半Heusler热电材料中有10个被算出的结果保留。机器学习预测的谱会丢失大部分带隙，而谱相似度指标未能察觉这一点，但预测谱仍能把通过测试的化合物排到接近顶部。最终筛选认定80个计算候选，其中61个尚无实测报道。
AI.conclusion: 无论由计算还是机器学习预测得到，DOS都足以用于决定"该计算什么"；但只有能带结构才能确认带隙是否存在。该工作为基于DOS的筛选流程提供了大规模验证，并给出了可实验检验的候选清单。

title: Orientation-Resolved Nanoindentation of Single Crystal Ti-15Mo: Inverted Elastic Anisotropy and Yield-Onset Behavior Beyond Simple CRSS Predictions
summary: Ti-15Mo (wt%) is a well-established $β$-stabilized alloy whose mechanical response is strongly governed by phase stability and deformation mechanisms that operate at the single-grain scale. Because these intragranular mechanisms are intrinsically anisotropic, understanding the orientation dependence of the elastic and plastic response is critical to the texture-engineered processing of wrought components. Here, we quantify the nanomechanical anisotropy of single-crystal Ti-15Mo by combining EBSD with nanoindentation to correlate hardness, indentation modulus, strain rate sensitivity, and indentation yield response with the crystallographic surface normal near $\langle111\rangle,\langle124\rangle,\langle011\rangle,\langle023\rangle$, and $\langle013\rangle$ directions. While the modulus anisotropy is small (~10%), contrary to the prediction for a cubic crystal with A>1, orientations near $\langle111\rangle$ exhibit the lowest moduli. Yield onset is likewise softest near $\langle111\rangle$ and spans 41%, while hardness spans only 6.6% and follows neither the modulus nor the yield ordering. The alloy also exhibits yield behavior not captured by the simple CRSS/Schmid-factor models evaluated here. Strain-rate-jump tests yield V*=18-31b$^3$, consistent with kink-pair-nucleation-controlled plasticity; based on V*, the orientations separate into two groups suggestive of glide-dominated versus twin/transformation-participating response. We reveal an inversion of the elastic anisotropy expected for a homogeneous cubic $β$-phase and an orientation-dependent yield-onset response that is not reproduced by the simple Schmid-factor models examined here. Retained athermal $ω$ is proposed as the contributor because $β\rightarrowω$ collapse occurs on {111}$_β$ planes and may provide anelastic compliance through the reversible $ω\rightarrowβ$ transformation.

AI.tldr: 通过EBSD联用纳米压痕，量化单晶Ti-15Mo在不同取向下的纳米力学各向异性，发现弹性各向异性出现反常倒置，且屈服起始的取向依赖无法用简单Schmid因子模型解释。
AI.motivation: Ti-15Mo为β稳定合金，其力学响应受单晶尺度相稳定性与变形机制控制，这些晶内机制本质各向异性，因此需厘清弹性与塑性响应的取向依赖性，以支撑织构工程化加工。
AI.method: 将EBSD与纳米压痕结合，测定近⟨111⟩、⟨124⟩、⟨011⟩、⟨023⟩、⟨013⟩取向的表面法向对应的硬度、压痕模量、应变速率敏感性和压痕屈服响应；并开展应变速率跃变试验求活化体积V*。
AI.result: 模量各向异性仅约10%，但近⟨111⟩取向模量最低，与A>1立方晶体的预测相反；屈服起始在⟨111⟩附近最软、跨度41%，硬度跨度仅6.6%且顺序既不随模量也不随屈服；屈服行为无法由所评估的简单CRSS/Schmid因子模型描述；V*=18–31b³，符合扭折对形核控制塑性，并据此将取向分为滑移主导与孪生/相变参与两类。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了均质立方β相弹性各向异性的倒置及简单Schmid模型无法再现的取向依赖屈服起始；提出残留非热ω相为成因——β→ω塌缩发生于{111}_β面，可通过可逆ω→β转变提供滞弹性柔量。

title: Coherent Phonon Generation from Prethermal Carrier Populations in a Semiconductor
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures; Supplemental Material: 22 pages, 9 figures, appended
summary: Ultrafast laser excitation of carriers in semiconductors often results in the creation of fully symmetric coherent optical phonons, typically understood in terms of a thermalized transient carrier population. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. The measured spectral dependence is instead reproduced by a transition-resolved prethermal force weighted by optical matrix elements and band- and momentum-dependent $A_1$ deformation potentials. Fitting this model to the data yields an excited transition state lifetime of a few femtoseconds. These results identify transition selectivity, rather than a thermalized total carrier density, as a key factor controlling coherent-phonon generation in semiconductors excited near a band gap.

AI.tldr: 碲中带隙附近激发时，全对称A1相干声子的振幅几乎不随激发光子能量变化，这否定了"热化载流子密度主导"图像；实验与第一性原理表明，由跃迁分辨的预热力（受光学矩阵元与形变势加权）主导相干声子产生，拟合给出约几飞秒的激发跃迁态寿命。
AI.motivation: 半导体中超快激光激发载流子通常产生全对称相干光学声子，传统上以热化瞬态载流子布居来解释。作者检验这一理解是否正确，特别是在激发波长跨越电子带隙时，相干声子振幅是否如热化模型所预测那样随激发能量变化。
AI.method: 以碲为对象，采用系统的超快泵浦-探测测量（激发波长扫过带隙附近），并结合第一性原理计算，研究相干声子产生的光子能量依赖性；将测得的谱依赖与"跃迁分辨的预热力"模型比较，该模型以光学矩阵元及带与动量依赖的A1形变势加权。
AI.result: 与热化载流子布居模型预期相反，全对称A1模的相干振幅在波长跨越带隙时仅微弱变化；该谱依赖被跃迁分辨的预热力模型成功再现，拟合得到激发跃迁态寿命约为几飞秒。
AI.conclusion: 控制带隙附近激发半导体中相干声子产生的主导因素是"跃迁选择性"而非热化总载流子密度，这揭示了预热过程中跃迁分辨力对相干声子产生的重要性。

title: MINFF: A Family of Classical Force Fields for Minerals with Tunable Angle Terms
comment: 63 pages, 7 figures and 3 tables in the main text. Supporting information (included in the same file) has 19 pages with 9 figures and 5 tables. Parameters, reference structures, misc. scripts and topology generators available via https://github.com/mholmboe/minff and https://www.atomipy.io
summary: Atomistic simulations of minerals are limited by the accuracy and transferability of the force field. We introduce MINFF, a force field family for layered and non-layered oxides and hydroxides of M being Si, Al, Fe, Mg, Ca, Ti, Li and F. MINFF has no M-O bond terms. Instead M-O distances follow from electrostatics and dispersion, while a single harmonic angle term on all M-O triplets controls coordination geometry. Metal charges are DDEC6 charges from reference mineral structures, and oxygen charges are assigned by nearest-neighbour charge smearing, covering basal, apical, hydroxyl and edge sites and sites adjacent to isomorphous substitutions. The oxygen Lennard-Jones parameters are based on the OPC3 water model and change by less than 5% when re-optimised per mineral, so compatibility with OPC3 and related ion-pair potentials is measured rather than assumed. Metal Lennard-Jones parameters were fitted to unit-cell metrics, bond distances and angles, both synchronously across more than 30 reference minerals (general, GMINFF) and for individual minerals (tailored, TMINFF), each at four angle force constants (0, 250, 500 and 1500 kJ/mol/rad^2). With angle terms, MINFF reproduces experimental unit-cells metrics to within 0.5% and atom-type distances and angles to within 0.7-1.4% and 0.1-0.4%, with Global Instability Index values as low as 0.11, below those of CLAYFF (0.34) and INTERFACE (0.21). A moderate angle constant reproduces the stiff in-plane and soft shear elastic constants of phyllosilicates and improves the Kaolinite librational bands, and in hydrated Na-Montmorillonite MINFF gives the lowest residual factor against the 2W 00l pattern of the models tested. The general and tailored sets at four angle stiffnesses give direct control over the transferability-fidelity trade-off. Topologies can be generated with the atom (MATLAB) and atomipy (Python) libraries and at www.atomipy.io.

AI.tldr: The paper introduces MINFF, a new force field family for layered and non-layered oxides and hydroxides containing Si, Al, Fe, Mg, Ca, Ti, Li and F. Instead of explicit M-O bond terms, it uses electrostatics and dispersion to set M-O distances plus a single harmonic angle term to control coordination geometry, using DDEC6 metal charges and site-dependent oxygen charges. Two parameter sets (general GMINFF and tailored TMINFF) at four angle force constants provide a tunable transferability-fidelity trade-off, and the force field reproduces unit-cell metrics, distances, angles, elastic constants, vibrational bands and diffraction patterns, while remaining compatible with the OPC3 water model.
AI.motivation: Atomistic simulations of minerals are limited by the accuracy and transferability of existing force fields. MINFF is motivated by the need for a force field that can handle both layered and non-layered oxides/hydroxides of key elements with better accuracy and controlled transferability than alternatives.
AI.method: MINFF has no M-O bond terms: M-O distances follow from electrostatics and dispersion, with a single harmonic angle term on all M-O triplets controlling coordination geometry. Metal charges are DDEC6 charges from reference structures; oxygen charges are assigned by nearest-neighbour charge smearing covering basal, apical, hydroxyl, edge sites and sites adjacent to isomorphous substitutions. Oxygen Lennard-Jones parameters are based on the OPC3 water model. Metal LJ parameters were fitted to unit-cell metrics, bond distances and angles, both synchronously across 30+ reference minerals (GMINFF) and per mineral (TMINFF), each at four angle force constants (0, 250, 500, 1500 kJ/mol/rad²).
AI.result: With angle terms, MINFF reproduces experimental unit-cell metrics within 0.5% and atom-type distances/angles within 0.7–1.4% and 0.1–0.4%, with Global Instability Index values as low as 0.11 (below CLAYFF's 0.34 and INTERFACE's 0.21). A moderate angle constant reproduces stiff in-plane and soft shear elastic constants of phyllosilicates and improves Kaolinite librational bands. In hydrated Na-Montmorillonite, MINFF gives the lowest residual factor against the 2W 00l pattern among tested models. Oxygen LJ re-optimisation changes parameters by less than 5%, confirming measured compatibility with OPC3.
AI.conclusion: The general (GMINFF) and tailored (TMINFF) sets at four angle stiffnesses give direct control over the transferability-fidelity trade-off. Topologies can be generated with the atom (MATLAB) and atomipy (Python) libraries and at www.atomipy.io.

title: Transition-Metal-Induced Uniaxial Anisotropy in YFe$_3$
summary: Achieving uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy while preserving high magnetization and thermal stability remains a central challenge in the development of Fe-rich permanent magnets. YFe$_3$ is a promising candidate owing to its saturation magnetization and Curie temperature, but its intrinsic easy-plane anisotropy limits its potential for permanent-magnet applications. Here, we show that selective transition-metal substitution drives an easy-plane-to-easy-axis transition in YFe$_3$. Systematic first-principles screening identifies V, Nb, and Ta as effective dopants, with YFe$_{2.33}$Ta$_{0.67}$ exhibiting a large uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy of 2.3~MJ/m$^{3}$. Calculated exchange interactions and atomistic Monte Carlo simulations show that the enhanced anisotropy is achieved while preserving robust ferromagnetic order and high thermal stability. Micromagnetic simulations further reveal that YFe$_{2.33}$Ta$_{0.67}$ exhibits the highest coercivity and strongest resistance to irreversible demagnetization, whereas YFe$_{2.33}$V$_{0.67}$ achieves a comparable maximum energy product at 300~K. Experimental characterization of V-alloyed YFe$_3$ shows that the YFe$_3$ phase can be retained at low nominal V concentrations (1-3 at.\%) under the employed synthesis and heat-treatment conditions, whereas higher V contents lead to increasingly multiphase samples. Concentration-dependent MAE calculations reveal a sign reversal between approximately 11 and 14~at.\% V, marking the transition from easy-plane to uniaxial easy-axis anisotropy. Consistent with this concentration dependence, electron backscatter diffraction and Kerr microscopy reveal in-plane magnetic domain structures in the experimentally accessible low-V regime. Therefore, our work offers a promising approach to tuning the magnetocrystalline anisotropy of YFe$_3$ while retaining high Curie temperatures.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理筛选过渡金属（V、Nb、Ta）掺杂实现YFe3从易面到易轴各向异性转变，YFe2.33Ta0.67获得2.3 MJ/m³单轴磁晶各向异性能并保持高居里温度与热稳定性。
AI.motivation: Fe基永磁体需同时具备单轴磁晶各向异性、高磁化强度与高热稳定性。YFe3饱和磁化强度和居里温度优异，但本征易面各向异性限制了其永磁应用，亟需调控手段。
AI.method: 系统第一性原理筛选过渡金属掺杂元素；计算交换作用并进行原子尺度蒙特卡罗模拟评估热稳定性；结合微磁学模拟矫顽力与抗退磁能力；实验合成V合金化YFe3，用EBSD与Kerr显微镜表征畴结构，并做浓度依赖MAE计算。
AI.result: V、Nb、Ta为有效掺杂元素；YFe2.33Ta0.67单轴MAE达2.3 MJ/m³，铁磁序与热稳定性良好，矫顽力最高、抗不可逆退磁最强；YFe2.33V0.67在300 K下最大磁能积相当。实验上低V浓度(1–3 at.%)可保留YFe3相，高V导致多相；MAE在约11–14 at.% V间发生符号反转，与低V区观察到的面内畴结构一致。
AI.conclusion: 选择性过渡金属取代可有效调控YFe3磁晶各向异性并保持高居里温度，为Fe基永磁材料设计提供了可行途径；但实验上实现高V/Ta掺杂的易轴相仍受相稳定性制约。

title: Accurately Generalizing Deep-Learning Hamiltonian Methods to Plane-Wave Density Functional Theory
summary: Deep neural networks that predict density functional theory (DFT) Hamiltonians from material structures offer a route to efficient electronic-structure calculations. However, extending localized atomic-orbital (AO) Hamiltonian learning to plane-wave (PW) calculations with hybrid functionals requires a compact AO representation that preserves the effects of nonlocal operators. Here we propose a projectability-guided construction of nonorthogonal AO Hamiltonians from a small, selected set of PW eigenstates and eigenvalues. High-projectability states are retained, and selected higher-energy states complete the AO subspace, avoiding an empirical shift and its arbitrary contribution to the learning targets. Because the construction uses PW eigenstates and eigenvalues, it incorporates nonlocal contributions present in the reference calculation without explicitly reconstructing their AO matrix elements. Benchmarks for MoS2 and sodium phases show accurate reproduction of PW bands with smaller AO bases than real-space reconstruction. The resulting PBE and HSE Hamiltonians can be learned by equivariant neural networks, connecting PW reference calculations with electronic-structure prediction. This approach broadens the range of PW DFT calculations available for AO Hamiltonian learning and enables compact, accurate training targets for developing more widely applicable electronic-structure models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"可投影性引导"的方法，从少量精选的平面波(PW)本征态与本征值构造非正交原子轨道(AO)哈密顿量，使含非局域算符的杂化泛函PW计算也能用于AO哈密顿量学习。
AI.motivation: 用深度学习从材料结构预测DFT哈密顿量可加速电子结构计算，但把局域AO哈密顿量学习推广到含杂化泛函的PW计算时，缺乏一个既能保持非局域算符效应、又足够紧凑的AO表示。
AI.method: 选取投影性高的PW本征态保留，并用选定的较高能态补全AO子空间，从而避免经验性能移及其对学习目标的任意贡献。由于直接利用PW本征态和本征值，方法天然包含参考计算中的非局域贡献，无需显式重建其AO矩阵元；随后用等变神经网络学习所得PBE与HSE哈密顿量。
AI.result: 在MoS2和钠相的基准测试中，以比实空间重建更小的AO基准确复现了PW能带；所得PBE与HSE哈密顿量可由等变神经网络学习。
AI.conclusion: 该方法拓宽了可用于AO哈密顿量学习的PW DFT计算范围，为发展更通用的电子结构模型提供了紧凑而准确的训练目标。

title: Reversible Magneto-ionic Modification of Metallic Magnetic Thin Films
summary: Magnetic multilayers with structural inversion asymmetry, perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA), and large Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) are widely studied for magnetic domain wall- and skyrmion-based data processing applications. In this work, we report a controlled, nonvolatile, but reversible local modification of such a system by electrically driven oxygen migration through the metallic film structure by using ionic liquid gating. Our findings provide direct evidence for the modification of the oxidation state at the heavy metal (HM)/ferromagnet (FM) interface. As a result, we observed changes in fundamental magnetic properties, such as an increase in the effective anisotropy constant (Keff) and coercive field (Hc) with oxidation, and a decrease with the reduction of oxygen ions. Positive gate voltages relative to the thin film extract oxygen ions from the magnetic layer, significantly reducing the domain nucleation field. In contrast, negative voltages drive oxygen ions into the magnetic layer, leading to a reversible increase in the extent of domain wall pinning near saturation. We observe a corresponding decrease in the magnetic moment and DMI, with negative voltage reducing both. This magneto-ionic modulation in fully metallic structures is beneficial for spintronic device applications, particularly in field-programmable domain wall and skyrmion devices.

AI.tldr: 利用离子液体门控实现氧离子在金属多层膜中的电驱动迁移，从而非易失、可逆地调控HM/FM界面氧化态，改变磁各向异性、矫顽场、畴壁钉扎与DMI。
AI.motivation: 具有结构反演不对称、垂直磁各向异性和大DMI的磁性多层膜是畴壁与斯格明子器件的重要平台，但需要一种可控、非易失且可逆的方式原位调节其界面磁性与DMI。
AI.method: 采用离子液体门控对全金属磁性多层膜施加正/负栅压，驱动氧离子在金属膜结构中迁移，并通过磁性测量表征HM/FM界面氧化态及磁性能变化。
AI.result: 直接观察到HM/FM界面氧化态的改变：氧化使有效各向异性常数Keff和矫顽场Hc增大，还原使其减小；正栅压抽出氧离子、显著降低畴壁成核场，负栅压注入氧离子、可逆增强近饱和区畴壁钉扎，并降低磁矩与DMI。
AI.conclusion: 该磁离子调控可在全金属结构中可逆、非易失地调节磁性与DMI，适用于可现场编程的畴壁与斯格明子自旋电子器件。

title: Substrate-controlled epitaxial-like growth of photochromic yttrium oxyhydride thin films
summary: Yttrium oxyhydride (YHO) thin films are synthesised by reactive magnetron sputtering of \b{eta}-YHx precursor films onto single-crystalline yttria-stabilised zirconia (YSZ) (111) and (100) substrates at 200 °C, followed by post-deposition oxidation in air. For comparison, reference films are also prepared on amorphous SiO2 and soda-lime glass substrates at both 200 °C and room temperature (RT). The structural (X-ray diffraction and scanning electron microscopy), compositional (elastic recoil detection analysis), and optical properties, including photochromic behaviour, of the films are systematically investigated. The results reveal a strong influence of substrate orientation on the film microstructure and crystallographic texture, leading to epitaxial-like growth with a mosaic spread of ~3-4°. YHO deposited on YSZ(100) exhibits larger crystallite sizes (10-20 nm) than YHO grown on YSZ(111) (~8 nm) and exhibits residual in-plane compressive strain while remaining largely relaxed with respect to the substrate. Compositional analysis revealed that the O/Y and O/H atomic ratios ranged from 0.71 to 0.82 and from 0.33 to 0.44, respectively, for films deposited under optimised conditions. These films exhibit photochromic behaviour under solar simulator illumination, with relative transmittance changes ranging from 7 to 22 % after 10 min of illumination. Despite the pronounced structural differences, the epitaxial-like films show no systematic improvement in photochromic response, indicating that the effect is governed primarily by composition. The study shows that the bleaching time constant increases exponentially with increasing contrast reached during illumination, rather than representing an intrinsic material constant of YHO.

AI.tldr: 采用反应磁控溅射在YSZ(111)/(100)单晶衬底上200°C沉积β-YHx并空气中氧化制备YHO薄膜，系统研究衬底取向对结构、成分与光致变色性能的影响，发现光响应主要受成分控制而非外延结构。
AI.motivation: 钇氧氢化物(YHO)具光致变色潜力，但衬底取向/外延生长对薄膜微结构与光致变色性能的影响尚不明确，需厘清结构因素与成分因素各自的作用。
AI.method: 200°C反应磁控溅射β-YHx前驱膜于YSZ(111)/(100)单晶衬底，空气后氧化得YHO；以非晶SiO2与钠钙玻璃(200°C与室温)作参照。用XRD、SEM表征结构，ERDA测成分，并测光学与光致变色性能。
AI.result: YSZ衬底诱导类外延生长，mosaic展宽约3–4°；YSZ(100)上晶粒10–20 nm大于YSZ(111)上约8 nm，并存在面内残余压应变；优化条件下O/Y=0.71–0.82、O/H=0.33–0.44；太阳模拟器光照10 min相对透过率变化7–22%；类外延膜未显示系统性的光致变色提升；漂白时间常数随光照对比度增大呈指数增长。
AI.conclusion: 衬底取向显著影响YHO微结构与织构，但光致变色效应主要由成分决定；漂白时间常数并非YHO的材料本征常数，而是依赖所达对比度的非本征量。

title: Flexoelectricity and Flexomagnetism
comment: 34 pages, 3 figures. Chapter to appear in The Effects of Curvature in Condensed Matter Physics, eds. P. Gentile, D. Makarov, C. Ortix (Springer, Springer Tracts in Modern Physics)
summary: Strain gradients, unlike homogeneous strain, are odd under space inversion and unlock couplings that are strictly forbidden in the parent crystal. At the nanoscale, and in curved low-dimensional systems in particular, such gradients are readily attainable and often unavoidable, so that curvature acts as a symmetry-breaking field written into the lattice itself. This chapter reviews the resulting couplings to electric polarization and magnetism. After establishing the geometric relation between strain gradients and curvature, we review flexoelectricity as the better-established reference case: the bulk, surface and dynamic contributions that complicate its definition, its microscopic mechanisms, its manifestation in two-dimensional materials, and the first-principles methodology now available for its calculation. Using the magnetoelectric effect as a conceptual bridge, we then develop flexomagnetism in a broad sense, covering any coupling phenomena between magnetism and strain gradients, and specifically discuss the linear magnetization response to curvature and curvature-induced Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, beyond the established curvilinear treatment. Finally, we briefly describe some additional effects fitting under this broad umbrella of flexomagnetism, including nonlinear ones, inhomogeneous magnetoelectric and Rashba-type phenomena, and connections to altermagnetism.

AI.tldr: 综述应变梯度（在弯曲低维体系中即曲率）作为内禀对称破缺场，所引发电极化（挠曲电）与磁性（挠曲磁）耦合。
AI.motivation: 均匀应变不能打破空间反演对称性，而应变梯度是奇宇称量，可解锁母晶体中严格禁戒的耦合；纳米尺度与弯曲低维体系中梯度难以避免，使曲率成为写进晶格的对称破缺场，需要系统梳理由此衍生的极性与磁性耦合。
AI.method: 综述性工作：先建立应变梯度与曲率的几何关系；以挠曲电为较成熟参照，讨论其体、表面与动态贡献带来的定义困难、微观机制、二维材料中的表现及第一性原理计算方法；以磁电效应为概念桥梁，将挠曲磁推广为磁性与应变梯度的一切耦合，重点讨论线性磁化对曲率的响应与曲率诱导的Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用（超越既有曲线坐标处理）。
AI.result: 给出挠曲电与挠曲磁的统一框架，指出曲率诱导DMI等新耦合可超出传统曲线化处理的描述，并归纳非线性效应、非均匀磁电与Rashba型现象以及与交错磁性的联系等其他效应。
AI.conclusion: 应变梯度/曲率是低维与纳米体系中普遍且难以回避的对称破缺来源，为极性与磁性的可控耦合提供新途径，挠曲电—挠曲磁框架值得进一步理论与第一性原理拓展。

title: Imaging Gate-Tunable Single-Layer Molecular Kagome Lattices
summary: Kagome lattices provide a simple geometry for engineering electronic states that exhibit novel quantum behavior. In conventional kagome materials, however, the relevant states are often embedded in chemically complex three-dimensional crystals and are difficult to isolate or tune. Molecule-based kagome networks offer structural precision and tunability, but have largely been confined to metallic substrates incompatible with 2D devices. Here we report growth of single-layer Ni$_3$(HITP)$_2$ metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) on van der Waals substrates including graphene-based field-effect devices using metal-salt molecular beam epitaxy. Low-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy resolves kagome-derived flat-band and van Hove singularity-based spectral features consistent with first-principles calculations. Gating hybrid 2D MOF devices allows us to energetically shift kagome spectral features, thus establishing electrostatic control of chemically programmable 2D kagome electronic lattices.

AI.tldr: 首次在石墨烯等范德华衬底上外延生长单层Ni₃(HITP)₂金属有机框架kagome晶格，观测到平带与van Hove奇异性特征，并通过栅压实现对这些电子态的能量调控。
AI.motivation: 传统kagome材料的状态常嵌在化学复杂的三维晶体中，难以隔离或调控；而分子基kagome网络多局限于与二维器件不兼容的金属衬底。
AI.method: 采用金属盐分子束外延法，在石墨烯基场效应器件等范德华衬底上生长单层Ni₃(HITP)₂ MOF；用低温扫描隧道谱解析能谱特征，并与第一性原理计算对照；对杂化二维MOF器件施加栅压。
AI.result: 低温扫描隧道谱分辨出kagome衍生的平带和van Hove奇异性谱学特征，与第一性原理计算结果一致；栅压可使kagome谱学特征发生能量移动。
AI.conclusion: 实现了对化学可编程二维kagome电子晶格的静电控制，为在二维器件中研究可调kagome物理提供平台。

title: Direct growth of crystalline spinel GaON films: A wide-bandgap mixed-anion semiconductor
summary: Mixed-anion semiconductors offer opportunities for bandgap engineering beyond conventional multication alloys, but competing phases and disorder complicate their synthesis and the identification of their electronic properties. Gallium oxynitride (GaON) could connect the technologically important GaN and Ga2O3 systems, yet establishing a clear relation between its crystal structure, composition and bandgap remains challenging. Here we report the direct growth of crystalline spinel gamma-GaON films by nitrogen-plasma-assisted pulsed-laser deposition. Varying the nitrogen and oxygen supply yields monoclinic beta-Ga2O3, predominantly disordered films and crystalline spinel GaON. Complementary diffraction, atomic-resolution microscopy and elemental analysis establish the spinel structure and nitrogen incorporation. Temperature-dependent photocurrent spectroscopy reveals a clear redshift of the crystalline gamma-GaON response, supporting assignment of a band-edge transition near 4.3 eV at room temperature. These results open opportunities to investigate mixed-anion wide-bandgap semiconductor physics and develop heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 通过氮等离子体辅助脉冲激光沉积直接生长出晶态尖晶石型γ-GaON薄膜，并测定其带边跃迁约为4.3 eV。
AI.motivation: 混合阴离子半导体可实现超越传统多阳离子合金的带隙工程，但竞争相与无序使其合成及电子性质表征困难；GaON有望连接GaN与Ga2O3体系，但其晶体结构、组分与带隙的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用氮等离子体辅助脉冲激光沉积生长薄膜，通过调节氮氧供给获得β-Ga2O3、以无序为主薄膜和晶态尖晶石GaON；结合衍射、原子分辨显微与元素分析确认尖晶石结构与氮掺入，并用变温光电流谱研究带边行为。
AI.result: 获得晶态尖晶石γ-GaON薄膜；变温光电流谱显示晶态γ-GaON响应明显红移，支持室温下约4.3 eV的带边跃迁归属。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为研究混合阴离子宽带隙半导体物理及构建异质结构提供了材料基础。

title: Time-Resolved Phonon Dispersions of Thermally Excited Graphite at the Nanoscale
summary: Lattice vibrations govern the propagation of heat in materials, and investigating their dynamics through time-resolved phonon dispersion measurements would provide insight into these excitations and their interactions. However, time-resolved measurements that directly resolve the phonon dispersion at the nanoscale have not been previously demonstrated. Momentum-resolved vibrational electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) provides access to phonon energies and momenta with nanoscale spatial resolution. Here, we combine momentum-resolved vibrational EELS with pulsed laser heating and synchronised gated electron detection to observe the phonon dispersion of graphite during controlled heating and cooling on the microsecond timescale. Recording both the gain and loss spectra at defined times relative to laser excitation, we determine the temperature at each time delay and follow changes to the phonon branches as a function of temperature. The momentum-resolved spectra reveal a decrease in energy of the optical phonon branch with increasing temperature accompanied by an increase in peak width. These changes are consistent with temperature-dependent phonon renormalisation and scattering associated with anharmonic interactions. The approach is compatible with detector gating on timescales down to 50 ns, providing a route towards extending these measurements to faster dynamics. This work demonstrates time-resolved phonon dispersion spectroscopy using vibrational EELS and provides a route towards probing temperature-dependent phonon dynamics at the nanoscale with simultaneous energy and momentum resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文结合动量分辨振动EELS、脉冲激光加热与同步门控电子探测，首次实现微秒尺度时间分辨的声子色散测量，观测到石墨光学声子支随升温能量下降、峰宽增大，归因于非谐相互作用导致的声子重整化与散射。
AI.motivation: 晶格振动决定热传导，需要时间分辨声子色散测量以理解激发及其相互作用，但此前尚无在纳米尺度直接分辨声子色散的时间分辨方法。
AI.method: 将动量分辨振动电子能量损失谱(EELS)与脉冲激光加热、同步门控电子探测相结合；在相对激光激发设定的时间延迟记录增益与损耗谱，确定各延迟温度并追踪声子支随温度的变化。
AI.result: 动量分辨谱显示随温度升高光学声子支能量下降、峰宽增大，与温度相关的声子重整化和非谐相互作用散射一致；探测门控可兼容低至50 ns的时间尺度。
AI.conclusion: 工作展示了基于振动EELS的时间分辨声子色散谱学，为在纳米尺度同时具备能量与动量分辨地探测温度相关声子动力学提供了途径，并可扩展至更快动力学。

title: Composition-controlled optical fingerprints and anisotropy of self-trapped excitons in double perovskites
summary: Double perovskites (DPs) offer a compositionally versatile platform for photocatalysis and optoelectronics, but their soft lattices favor strong exciton-phonon coupling and self-trapped excitons (STEs), which produce broad, red-shifted photoluminescence (PL). Here, we combine optical spectroscopy and ab initio calculations to study lead-free, Sb-doped Cs2BInCl6 nanocrystals with B-site alloying from Na to K. Alloying tunes the PL energy from about 2.48 to 2.70 eV, while absorption features near 3.8 eV remain nearly unchanged. Calculations reveal that Sb doping enables bright radiative recombination channels and delocalizes the excitonic wavefunction. We identify STEs responsible for the large PL red shift, associated with an upward shift of dopant-hybridized in-gap states. Na-to-K substitution selectively changes the STE lattice distortion, explaining why PL varies strongly with composition while absorption does not. Theory further predicts pronounced PL polarization anisotropy that reflects the STE wavefunction's spatial structure and depends on B-site composition. Time-resolved anisotropy measurements closely agree with these predictions, providing experimental fingerprints of the excitonic wavefunction and its evolution with alloying. Together, these results disentangle the roles of doping and alloying in lead-free DPs and establish polarization-resolved spectroscopy as a probe of STE wavefunctions.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合光谱与第一性原理计算，考察Na至K的B位合金化对无铅Sb掺杂Cs2BInCl6纳米晶的影响，揭示自陷激子（STE）主导的红移发光及其组分调控机制，并以偏振分辨光谱探测STE波函数。
AI.motivation: 双钙钛矿软晶格导致强激子-声子耦合与自陷激子，产生宽且红移的发光；掺杂与合金化各自作用尚不清晰，需厘清二者对发光与吸收的不同影响。
AI.method: 光学光谱与从头算计算相结合（ab initio），研究Sb掺杂Cs2BInCl6纳米晶，B位由Na到K合金化；并进行时间分辨偏振各向异性测量。
AI.result: 合金化使发光能量由约2.48 eV调至2.70 eV，而约3.8 eV吸收几乎不变；Sb掺杂引入明亮辐射复合通道并使激子波函数离域；STE与掺杂杂化带隙内态上移相关，Na→K选择性改变STE晶格畸变；理论预测的发光偏振各向异性与时间分辨测量高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了掺杂与合金化在无铅双钙钛矿中的作用，确立偏振分辨光谱作为探测STE波函数及其随组分演化的重要手段。

title: Revisiting magnetoelectric response in collinear antiferromagnetic zigzag chains: A downfolding approach beyond conventional low-energy models
summary: Magnetoelectric (ME) effects in antiferromagnets provide a fertile platform for exploring symmetry-driven cross-correlated responses. However, their microscopic origin remains elusive and is often obscured in simplified low-energy descriptions. In this study, we revisit the microscopic mechanism of the ME effect in a collinear antiferromagnetic zigzag chain by employing a multi-orbital tight-binding model that explicitly includes both $s$- and $p$-orbital degrees of freedom. Using analytical and numerical calculations based on the Kubo formula, we demonstrate that the ME response is governed by orbital degrees of freedom activated through $s$--$p$ hybridization, while the spin contribution vanishes due to spin conservation. To elucidate the low-energy description, we derive an effective Hamiltonian projected onto the $s$-orbital subspace using the Schur complement. We show that a naive application of the Kubo formula within this effective model fails to capture the ME response. This issue is resolved by systematically incorporating vertex corrections in terms of orbital hybridization into the response functions. Furthermore, by introducing a quasiparticle renormalization scheme, we formulate a renormalized Kubo formula that preserves conservation laws and accurately reproduces the full multi-orbital results. Our analysis revisits the conventional low-energy perspective and reveals that the ME effect originates from virtual interorbital processes encoded in vertex corrections, rather than from the bare low-energy Hamiltonian. The effective framework developed here provides a unified microscopic understanding of orbital-driven ME responses and offers a systematic route to incorporate hybridization effects beyond simple low-energy models.

AI.tldr: 本文用含s、p轨道的多轨道紧束缚模型研究共线反铁磁锯齿链的磁电(ME)效应微观机制，指出ME响应由s-p杂化激活的轨道自由度主导（自旋贡献因自旋守恒为零），并提出通过引入轨道杂化顶点修正与准粒子重整化的重整化Kubo公式以正确描述低能有效模型。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁体中的磁电效应是研究对称性驱动的交叉响应的重要平台，但其微观起源仍不清楚，且常被简化的低能描述所掩盖。作者希望重新审视共线反铁磁体系ME效应的微观机制，并厘清低能有效模型为何失效。
AI.method: 构建显式包含s轨道与p轨道自由度的多轨道紧束缚模型，刻画共线反铁磁锯齿链；基于Kubo公式进行解析与数值计算，区分自旋与轨道贡献；利用Schur complement将多轨道哈密顿量投影到s轨道子空间，导出低能有效哈密顿量；随后在响应函数中系统引入以轨道杂化为形式的顶点修正，并引入准粒子重整化方案，构造保持守恒律的重整化Kubo公式。
AI.result: ME响应由s-p杂化所激活的轨道自由度主导，而自旋贡献因自旋守恒而消失；在投影后的s轨道有效模型中直接应用Kubo公式无法捕捉ME响应；引入轨道杂化的顶点修正后可解决该问题，且准粒子重整化的Kubo公式能保持守恒律并准确重现完整多轨道模型的结果。
AI.conclusion: ME效应来源于编码在顶点修正中的虚轨道间过程，而非裸低能哈密顿量本身，这修正了传统的低能视角。所建立的有效框架为轨道驱动的ME响应提供了统一的微观理解，并为在简单低能模型之外系统纳入杂化效应提供了可行路径。
